name: Du'a for sustenance
arabic: وَٱرۡزُقۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
transliteration: Warzuqnaa wa Anta khayrur-raaziqeen
translation: Give us sustenance, for Thou art the Best of Sustainers

name: Du'a for wealth and knowledge
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

name: Du'a for getting a job and more: Allah is Sufficient for us
arabic: حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ
transliteration: Hasbona Allahu Wa Niama Al Wakeel
translation: Allah is Sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust

name: Du'a for getting a job and more: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرࣲ فَقِيرࣱ‏
transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
translation: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me

name: Du'a for applying for job or interviewing
arabic: رَّبِّ أَدۡخِلۡنِي مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقࣲ وَأَخۡرِجۡنِي مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقࣲ وَٱجۡعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلۡطَٰنࣰا نَّصِيرࣰا
transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqin waj'al lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa
translation: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power

name: Du'a for getting a job and more: Allah sufficeth me
arabic: حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Hasbe Allahu La Illaha Illa Huwa Alayhi Tawakaltu Wa Huwa Rabu Al Arshi Al Atheem
translation: Allah sufficeth me. There is no God save Him. In Him have I put my trust, and He is Lord of the Tremendous Throne

name: Du'a for lawful provision
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalalika 'an haramika, wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak
translation: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace so that I have no need of anyone besides You.

name: Du'a for good character
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min munkaratil-akhlaqi wal-a'mali wal-ahwa'
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from reprehensible manners, deeds, and whims.

name: Du'a for getting a job and more: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣰ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةࣰ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabana Aatina Fil Dunya Hasanah Wa Fil Akhirati Hasanah Wa Qina Athaab Al Naar
translation: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire

name: Du'a to be among the successful
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُفْلِحِينَ
transliteration: Allahummaj-'alna minal-muflihin
translation: O Allah, make us among the successful.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for blessing of pregnancy: My Lord! Leave me not childless
arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِي فَرۡدࣰا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi laa tadharnee fardan wa Anta khayrul waaritheen
translation: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors

name: A verse on Allah's creative power
arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏
transliteration: Wa lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumaa, yakhluqu maa yashaa', wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
translation: Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. He createth what He will. And Allah is Able to do all things
practiceTime: A verse to recite and reflect on during pregnancy, remembering that all creation rests in Allah's power.

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Khaliq
arabic: يَا خَالِقُ
transliteration: Ya khaliq
translation: O Creator
source: A general supplication calling on Allah by His Name al-Khāliq (the Creator); not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: A verse on Allah's knowledge of the womb
arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَحۡمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ ٱلۡأَرۡحَامُ وَمَا تَزۡدَادُۚ وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٍ عِندَهُۥ بِمِقۡدَارٍ
transliteration: Allaahu ya'lamu maa tahmilu kullu unthaa wa maa tagheedul arhaamu wa maa tazdaad, wa kullu shay'in 'indahu bi-miqdaar
translation: Allah knoweth that which every female beareth and that which the wombs absorb and that which they grow. And everything with Him is measured
practiceTime: A verse to recite and reflect on during pregnancy, finding comfort that every stage is known to Allah.

name: Du'a for blessed children
arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةࣰ طَيِّبَةًۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee mil ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka Samee'ud-du'aa'
translation: My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer

name: Du'a for children and pregnancy
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرࣲ فَقِيرࣱ‏
transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
translation: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me

name: Du'a for blessings
arabic: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa Anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen
translation: There is no God save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer

name: Du'a for blessing of pregnancy: Endure thou patiently (O Muhammad)
arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ وَمَا صَبۡرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيۡقࣲ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحۡسِنُونَ
transliteration: Wasbir wa maa sabruka illaa billaah, wa laa tahzan 'alayhim wa laa taku fee dayqim mimmaa yamkuroon. Innallaaha ma'al-ladheenat-taqaw wal-ladheena hum muhsinoon
translation: Endure thou patiently (O Muhammad). Thine endurance is only by (the help of) Allah. Grieve not for them, and be not in distress because of that which they devise Lo! Allah is with those who keep their duty unto Him and those who are doers of good

name: Recite Surah Ar-Rum for marriage disagreements
arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنۡ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجࣰا لِّتَسۡكُنُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَكُم مَّوَدَّةࣰ وَرَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
transliteration: Wa min aayaatihee an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwaajal li-taskunoo ilayhaa wa ja'ala baynakum mawaddatan wa rahmah, inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatil li-qawmiy yatafakkaroon
translation: And of His signs is this: He created for you helpmeets from yourselves that ye might find rest in them, and He ordained between you love and mercy. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who reflect

name: Recite Surah Ya-Sin for marriage
arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee khalaqal-azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul-ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon
translation: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not

name: Du'a for newly married
arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
transliteration: Barakallahu laka wa baraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayrin
translation: May Allah bless you, and send blessings upon you, and bring you both together in goodness.

name: Du'a for marital harmony
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
transliteration: Allahumma allif bayna qulubina wa aslih dhata baynina wahdina subulas-salam wa najjina minadh-dhulumati ilan-nur
translation: O Allah, reconcile our hearts, resolve our affairs, guide us to the paths of peace, and save us from darkness to the light.

name: Istikhara for marriage
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ فَإِنْ رَأَيْتَ أَنَّ فِي فُلَانَةٍ خَيْرًا لِي فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي فَاقْدُرْهَا لِي وَإِنْ كَانَ غَيْرُهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا لِي فِي دِينِي وَآخِرَتِي فَاقْدُرْهَا لِي
transliteration: Allahumma innaka taqdiru wa la aqdiru wa ta'lamu wa la a'lamu wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub fa'in ra'ayta anna fi fulanatin khayran li fi dini wa dunyaya wa akhirati faqdurha li wa in kana ghayruha khayran minha li fi dini wa akhirati faqdurha li
translation: O Allah, You have power and I have no power, and You know and I do not know, and You are the Knower of the unseen. Thus, if You see that there is good for me in so-and-so (female) concerning my religion, my worldly life, and my hereafter, then decree her for me. And if another besides her is better for me concerning my religion and my hereafter, then decree her for me.
source: A general supplication modelled on the Istikhāra (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 1162), naming the woman; not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for marriage
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَتَزَوَّجَ فَقَدِّرْ لِي مِنَ النِّسَاءِ أَعَفَّهُنَّ فَرْجاً وَأَحْفَظَهُنَّ لِي فِي نَفْسِهَا وَأَوْسَعَهُنَّ لِي رِزْقاً وَأَعْظَمَهُنَّ لِي بَرَكَةً فِي نَفْسِي وَمَالِي فَقَدِّرْ لِي مِنْهَا وَلَداً طَيِّباً تَجْعَلُهُ خَلَفاً صَالِحاً فِي حَيَاتِي وَبَعْدَ مَوْتِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni uridu an atazawwaja faqaddir li minan-nisa'i a'affahunna farjan wa ahfadhahunna li fi nafsiha wa awsa'ahunna li rizqan wa a'dhamahunna li barakatan fi nafsi wa mali faqaddir li minha waladan tayyiban taj'aluhu khalafan salihan fi hayati wa ba'da mawti
translation: O Allah, I wish to get married, so decree for me from among women the most chaste, the most protective of herself and my property, the most expansive in provision for me, and the greatest in blessing for me in myself and my property. And decree for me from her good offspring whom You make a righteous successor in my life and after my death.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a to bring husband and wife closer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَالْعَمَلَ الَّذِي يُبَلِّغُنِي حُبَّكَ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ حُبَّكَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ نَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuka wal-'amalal-ladhi yuballighuni hubbaka Allahummaj-'al hubbaka ahabba ilayya min nafsi wa ahli
translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, and the love of those who love You, and the deeds that will bring me to Your love. O Allah, make Your love more beloved to me than myself and my family.

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: Give us sustenance
arabic: وَٱرۡزُقۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
transliteration: Warzuqnaa wa Anta khayrur-raaziqeen
translation: Give us sustenance, for Thou art the Best of Sustainers

name: Du'a for knowledge and good provision
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

name: Du'a for wealth and children
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي مَالًا وَوَلَدًا وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي
transliteration: Allahummar-zuqni malan wa waladan, wa barik li fima a'taytani
translation: O Allah, grant me wealth and children, and bless for me what You have given me.
source: Adapted into the first person, with "grant me" in place of "increase", from Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6334, which reads "اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ" (O Allah, increase his wealth and offspring, and bless him in what You have given him).
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6334).

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah, Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali, Allahummas-tur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati, Allahummah-fazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi, wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an ughtala min tahti
translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from in front of me and from behind me, and from my right and from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being struck down from beneath me.

name: Du'a for sufficiency in the lawful
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalalika 'an haramika, wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak
translation: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace so that I have no need of anyone besides You.

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣰ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةࣰ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabana Aatina Fi Aldunya Hasanah Wa Fi Al Akhira Hasanah Wa Qina Aathab AlNaar
translation: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire

name: Du'a for guidance, piety, chastity and wealth
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina
translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and wealth.

name: Du'a to have a good business
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul Huwallaahu Ahad, Allaahus-Samad, lam yalid wa lam yoolad, wa lam yakul lahu kufuwan ahad
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: He is Allah, the One Allah, the eternally Besought of all He begetteth not nor was begotten And there is none comparable unto Him

name: Du'a for abundance in sustenance and repayment of debt
arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفُۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَوِيُّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ
transliteration: Allahu Lateef Be Ibaadihi Yarzoqqo Men Yashaa Wa Huwa Al Qawee Al Aziz
translation: Allah is gracious unto His slaves. He provideth for whom He will. And He is the Strong, the Mighty

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah
arabic: يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ، يَا رَبُّ يَا رَبُّ يَا رَبُّ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الْأَعْظَمِ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Ya Allahu ya Allahu ya Allah, ya Rabbu ya Rabbu ya Rabb, ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram, as'aluka bismikal-'azimil-a'zami an tarzuqani rizqan wasi'an halalan tayyiban birahmatika ya arhamar-rahimin
translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, O Possessor of Majesty and Honour, I ask You by Your great and supreme name to grant me a vast, lawful, and good provision by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: Vision comprehendeth Him not
arabic: لَّا تُدۡرِكُهُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدۡرِكُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَۖ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
transliteration: Laa tudrikuhul-absaaru wa Huwa yudrikul-absaar, wa Huwal-Lateeful-Khabeer
translation: Vision comprehendeth Him not, but He comprehendeth (all) vision. He is the Subtile, the Aware

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: And when We said: Go into this township
arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا ٱدۡخُلُواْ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةَ فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمۡ رَغَدࣰا وَٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡبَابَ سُجَّدࣰا وَقُولُواْ حِطَّةࣱ نَّغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ خَطَٰيَٰكُمۡۚ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa Ith Qolna Adkholo Hathihi Al Qarya Fa Kolo Minha Haytho Shetom Raghadan Wa Adkhilo Al Baba Sojodaa Wa Qooloo Hitaton Naghfir Lakom Khatayakom Wa Sanazeedu Al Mohseeneen
translation: And when We said: Go into this township and eat freely of that which is therein, and enter the gate prostrate, and say: "Repentance." We will forgive you your sins and will increase (reward) for the right-doers

name: Du'a to increase wealth
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالِي وَوَلَدِي وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي وَأَطِلْ حَيَاتِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَأَحْسِنْ عَمَلِي وَاغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: Allahumma akthir mali wa waladi, wa barik li fima a'taytani, wa atil hayati 'ala ta'atika, wa ahsin 'amali, wagh-fir li
translation: O Allah, increase my wealth and offspring, and bless for me what You have given me, and prolong my life in obedience to You, and rectify my deeds, and forgive me.
source: Adapted into the first person and appended with requests to prolong life in obedience, improve deeds, and grant forgiveness, from Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6334, which reads "اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ" (O Allah, increase his wealth and offspring, and bless him in what You have given him).
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6334).

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust
arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Rabbanaa 'alayka tawakkalnaa wa ilayka anabnaa wa ilaykal maseer
translation: Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: All praise is for Allah
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَرَّفَنِي نَفْسَهُ وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْنِي عُمْيَانَ الْقَلْبِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَنِي مِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ رِزْقِي فِي يَدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ رِزْقِي فِي أَيْدِي النَّاسِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَتَرَ ذُنُوبِي وَعُيُوبِي وَلَمْ يَفْضَحْنِي بَيْنَ الْخَلَائِقِ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi 'arrafani nafsahu wa lam yatrukni 'umyanal-qalb, alhamdulillahil-ladhi ja'alani min ummati Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa alih, alhamdulillahil-ladhi ja'ala rizqi fi yadayhi wa lam yaj'al rizqi fi aydin-nas, alhamdulillahil-ladhi satara dhunubi wa 'uyubi wa lam yafdahni baynal-khala'iq
translation: All praise is for Allah who made Himself known to me and did not leave me blind-hearted. All praise is for Allah who made me from the ummah of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). All praise is for Allah who placed my provision in His hands and did not place my provision in the hands of people. All praise is for Allah who concealed my sins and my flaws and did not disgrace me among the creation.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a to get rid of debt
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalalika 'an haramika, wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak
translation: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace so that I have no need of anyone besides You.

name: Du'a for wealth and sustenance: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرࣲ فَقِيرࣱ‏
transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
translation: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me

name: Du'a for debt: Oh Allah, I seek refuge in You from the burden of Debt
arabic: اللَّهُم اِنّي اَعوذُ بِكَ من غَلَبَة الدَيْن
transliteration: Allahum ma Ini Aaoutho Bika Min Ghalabat Al Dayn
translation: Oh Allah, I seek refuge in You from the burden of Debt
source: Adapted from Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6369, which includes "وَغَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ"
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6369).

name: Du'a for debt: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your unlawful
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalalika 'an haramika, wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak
translation: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace so that I have no need of anyone besides You.

name: Recite from the Qur'an: Surah Ali 'Imran to help with debt
arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ تُؤۡتِي ٱلۡمُلۡكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلۡمُلۡكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلۡخَيۡرُۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏ تُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَتُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَتُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّۖ وَتَرۡزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
transliteration: Qulillaahumma Maalikal-mulki tu'til-mulka man tashaa'u wa tanzi'ul-mulka mimman tashaa'u wa tu'izzu man tashaa'u wa tudhillu man tashaa', bi-yadikal-khayr, innaka 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Toolijul-layla fin-nahaari wa toolijun-nahaara fil-layl, wa tukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wa tukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayy, wa tarzuqu man tashaa'u bi-ghayri hisaab
translation: Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things Thou causest the night to pass into the day, and Thou causest the day to pass into the night. And Thou bringest forth the living from the dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead from the living. And Thou givest sustenance to whom Thou choosest, without stint

name: Du'a for exams and stressful times
arabic: رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةࣰ مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي
transliteration: Rabbish-rah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree wahlul 'uqdatam mil lisaanee yafqahoo qawlee
translation: My Lord! relieve my mind And ease my task for me And loose a knot from my tongue That they may understand my saying

name: Du'a for study
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَهْمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَحِفْظَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
transliteration: Allahumman-fa'ni bima 'allamtani wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni. Allahumma inni as'aluka fahman-nabiyyina wa hifdhal-mursalina wal-mala'ikatil-muqarrabin
translation: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, and teach me what will benefit me. O Allah, I ask You for the understanding of the prophets, the memory of the messengers, and the angels nearest to You.
source: Adapted from Sunan Ibn Mājah 251, which includes "اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا" (O Allah, benefit me by that which You have taught me, and teach me that which will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge). This version omits "and increase me in knowledge" and adds a request for the understanding of the prophets, the memory of the messengers and the angels nearest to Allah, which has no known narration.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan Ibn Mājah 251)

name: Du'a for exam
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahlan, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahlan.
translation: O Allah, there is nothing easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if it be Your Will.

name: Du'a for success in an exam or interview: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawmi fathahu wa nasrahu wa nurahu wa barakatahu wa hudah
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day, its victory, its help, its light, its blessings, and its guidance.

name: Du'a for success in an exam or interview: Be glorified! We have no knowledge
arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
transliteration: Subhaanaka laa 'ilma lanaa illaa maa 'allamtanaa, innaka Antal 'Aleemul Hakeem
translation: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Fattah
arabic: يَا فَتَّاحُ
transliteration: Ya Fattah
translation: O Opener
source: A general supplication using a Name of Allah, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for success in an exam or interview: (My course is) comely patience
arabic: فَصَبۡرࣱ جَمِيلࣱۖ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
transliteration: Fa-sabrun jameel, wallaahul musta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifoon
translation: (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe

name: Du'a for anxiety during exams
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a-uthu bika minal-hammi wal-hazn, wa a-uthu bika minal-ajzi wal-kasal, wa a-uthu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a-uthu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overpowered by debt and the oppression of others.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 1555 (ḍaʿīf; similar duʿāʾ in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6369)

name: Du'a for learning
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْنَا مَا يَنْفَعُنَا وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنَا وَزِدْنَا عِلْمًا
transliteration: Allahumma 'allimna ma yanfa'una wan-fa'na bima 'allamtana wa zidna 'ilman
translation: O Allah, teach us that which benefits us, and benefit us with what You have taught us, and increase us in knowledge.
source: Adapted in the plural and reordered from Sunan Ibn Mājah 251, which includes "اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا" (O Allah, benefit me by that which You have taught me, and teach me that which will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge).
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan Ibn Mājah 251)

name: Du'a for ease: My Lord! Relieve my mind
arabic: رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي
transliteration: Rabbish-rah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree
translation: My Lord! Relieve my mind And ease my task for me

name: Du'a for ease: O Allah, make me better than what they think of me
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُنُّونَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ وَلَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
transliteration: Allahummaj-'alni khayran mimma yadhunnun wagh-fir li ma la ya'lamun wa la tu'akhidhni bima yaqulun
translation: O Allah, make me better than what they think of me, and forgive me for what they do not know about me, and do not take me to account for what they say about me.
source: A supplication of Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq (may Allah be pleased with him), recorded in al-Adab al-Mufrad 761. Not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a to succeed in exams
arabic: فَإِنَّ حَسۡبَكَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصۡرِهِۦ وَبِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
transliteration: Fa-inna hasbakallaah, Huwal-ladhee ayyadaka bi-nasrihee wa bil-mu'mineen
translation: then lo! Allah is Sufficient for thee. He it is Who supporteth thee with His help and with the believers

name: Du'a for victory and success
arabic: رَّبِّ أَدۡخِلۡنِي مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقࣲ وَأَخۡرِجۡنِي مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقࣲ وَٱجۡعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلۡطَٰنࣰا نَّصِيرࣰا
transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqin waj'al lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa
translation: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power

name: Du'a after studying
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ مَا قَرَأْتُ وَمَا حَفِظْتُ فَرُدَّهُ عَلَيَّ عِنْدَ حَاجَتِي إِلَيْهِ إِنَّكَ عَلَى مَا تَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنْتَ حَسْبِي وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
transliteration: Allahumma inni astawdi'uka ma qara'tu wa ma hafizhtu faruddahu 'alayya 'inda hajati ilayh, innaka 'ala ma tasha'u qadir wa anta hasbi wa ni'mal-wakil
translation: O Allah, I entrust You with what I have read and what I have memorised. Bring it back to me when I am in need of it. You are capable of whatever You will, and You are sufficient for me, and the best disposer of affairs.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a to remove sorrow and grief: My Lord! relieve my mind
arabic: رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي
transliteration: Rabbi-shraḥ lī ṣadrī, wa yassir lī amrī
translation: My Lord! relieve my mind And ease my task for me

name: Du'a to remove sorrow and grief: Allah, Allah is my Lord
arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
transliteration: Allahu, Allahu rabbi, la ushriku bihi shay'a.
translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.

name: Du'a for fear: O Allah, conceal my faults and keep me safe from what I fear
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي
transliteration: Allahummas-tur 'awrati, wa amin raw'ati.
translation: O Allah, conceal my faults and keep me safe from what I fear.

name: Du'a for fear: O Allah, we place You before them
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
transliteration: Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim, wa na'udhu bika min shururihim.
translation: O Allah, we place You before them (those who intend harm) and we seek refuge in You from their evils.

name: Du'a for fear: There is no power and no strength except with Allah
arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'adhim.
translation: There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Supreme.
source: Adapted (adds "the Most High, the Supreme") from Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6384, which reads "لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ" (There is no power and no strength except with Allah).
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6384)

name: Du'a when feeling alarm, fear, anxiety or unrest in sleep
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa 'iqabihi wa sharri 'ibadihi, wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdurun.
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the suggestions of devils and from their presence.

name: Du'a for protection from stress, hunger, disgrace and injustice
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْفَاقَةِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-faqri wal-faqati wal-qillati wadh-dhillati, wa a'udhu bika min an adhlima aw udhlam.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, want, scarcity, and humiliation, and I seek refuge in You lest I wrong others or be wronged.
source: Adapted (adds "want") from Sunan Abī Dāwūd 1544, which reads "اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ" (O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, scarcity and humiliation, and I seek refuge in You lest I wrong others or be wronged).
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan Abī Dāwūd 1544)

name: Du'a for patience
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡنَا صَبۡرࣰا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسۡلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabana Afrigh Alayena Sabraan Wa Tawafana moslimeen
translation: Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness and make us die as men who have surrendered (unto Thee)

name: Du'a to deal with distress and depression
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبࣰا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa Dhun-Nun Itha Thahaba Moghadebaan Fa Than Ana Lan Naqdira Alaih Fanada Fi Altholomaat An La Illaha Illa Anta Subhanaka Inni Konto Mina Althalimeen
translation: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no God save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer

name: Du'a to deal with distress and heaviness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju, fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'aynin, wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu, la ilaha illa Anta.
translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.
grading: Ḥasan according to al-Albānī; ḍaʿīf according to al-Arnaʾūṭ

name: Du'a for rescue from tough situation
arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyumu, birahmatika astaghith.
translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek assistance.

name: Du'a before public speaking
arabic: رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةࣰ مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي
transliteration: Rabbish-rah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree wahlul 'uqdatam mil lisaanee yafqahoo qawlee
translation: My Lord! relieve my mind And ease my task for me And loose a knot from my tongue That they may understand my saying

name: Du'a upon sneezing
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillah
translation: All praise and thanks are to Allah.

name: Du'a for one who sneezes
arabic: يَرْحَمُكُمُ اللهُ
transliteration: Yarhamukumullah
translation: May Allah have mercy upon you.
source: Adapted to the plural from Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6224, which reads "yarḥamuka-llāh".
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6224)

name: Reply to the sneezer's du'a
arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
transliteration: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum
translation: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order.

name: Du'a upon hearing a rooster
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your favor.

name: Du'a upon hearing a dog bark
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim
translation: I seek protection in Allah from shaytan, the accursed one.

name: Du'a upon waking up
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
translation: All praise is for Allah, Who granted us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the Resurrection.

name: Du'a before sleep
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
transliteration: Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya
translation: O Allah, in Your name I die and I live.

name: Du'a for protection on Judgment Day
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak
translation: O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your slaves.

name: Du'a for good character
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
transliteration: Allahumma kama hassanta khalqi fahassin khuluqi
translation: O Allah, You have beautified my body, so do beautify my character.
source: Musnad Aḥmad 3823. Saying it on looking in a mirror is reported only with weak chains.

name: Du'a before entering the restroom
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith
translation: O Allah, I seek Your protection from the male and female devils.

name: Du'a upon leaving the restroom
arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ، الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنِّي الْأَذَى وَعَافَانِي
transliteration: Ghufranaka, alhamdu lillahil-ladhi adh-haba 'annil-adha wa 'afani
translation: I seek Your pardon. Praise be to Allah Who removed from me discomfort and gave me relief.
source: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 30 for "Ghufrānaka"; the rest is from Sunan Ibn Mājah 301.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ for "Ghufrānaka"; ḍaʿīf for the rest (al-Albānī)

name: Du'a when getting dressed
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
translation: All praise belongs to Allah, the One Who clothed me with this garment and gave it to me without any power or ability from me.

name: Du'a of gratitude before sleeping
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana, wa kafana, wa awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la mu'wi
translation: Praise is to Allah Who has provided us with food and with drink, sufficed us and gave us an abode, for how many are there with no provision and no home.
source: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2715 (said on going to bed)

name: Du'a before beginning a meal
arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَعَلَى بَرَكَةِ اللهِ
transliteration: Bismillahi wa 'ala barakatillah
translation: In the Name of Allah, and with the blessings of Allah I begin.
source: Adapted from Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 5376, which has "Bismillāh"; "wa ʿalā barakati-llāh" is a common addition not found in the narration.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 5376)

name: Du'a for blessings in food
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ، بِسْمِ اللهِ
transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fima razaqtana wa qina 'adhaban-nar, bismillah
translation: O Allah, bless the food You provided us and save us from the punishment of the fire. In the Name of Allah.

name: Du'a for children's protection
arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
transliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
translation: I seek protection for you both in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous pest, and from every envious blameworthy eye.

name: Du'a after the adhan
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil qa'imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa'adtah
translation: O Allah! Lord of this perfect call and of the regular prayer which is going to be established, give Muhammad the right of intercession and illustriousness, and resurrect him to the best and the highest place in Paradise that You promised him.

name: Du'a during strong winds
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha, wa khayra ma fiha, wa khayra ma ursilat bih, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bih
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this wind, for the good of what it contains, and for the good of what is sent with it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of it, from the evil of what it contains, and from the evil that is sent with it.

name: Du'a seeking refuge from four trials
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannama, wa min 'adhabil-qabri, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hellfire, and from the punishment of the grave, and from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.
practiceTime: After the final tashahhud (the testimony recited while seated in prayer), before ending the prayer

name: Beautiful ayah from Surah An-Nur
arabic: ۞ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشۡكَوٰةࣲ فِيهَا مِصۡبَاحٌۖ ٱلۡمِصۡبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوۡكَبࣱ دُرِّيࣱّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةࣲ زَيۡتُونَةࣲ لَّا شَرۡقِيَّةࣲ وَلَا غَرۡبِيَّةࣲ يَكَادُ زَيۡتُهَا يُضِيٓءُ وَلَوۡ لَمۡ تَمۡسَسۡهُ نَارࣱۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورࣲۚ يَهۡدِي ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَيَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَ لِلنَّاسِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمࣱ‏
transliteration: Allaahu noorus-samaawaati wal-ard, mathalu noorihee ka-mishkaatin feehaa misbaah, al-misbaahu fee zujaajah, az-zujaajatu ka-annahaa kawkabun durriyyuy yooqadu min shajaratim mubaarakatin zaytoonatil laa sharqiyyatin wa laa gharbiyyatin yakaadu zaytuhaa yudee'u wa law lam tamsas-hu naar, noorun 'alaa noor, yahdillaahu li-noorihee man yashaa', wa yadribullaahul-amthaala lin-naas, wallaahu bi-kulli shay'in 'Aleem
translation: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things

name: Du'a for fulfillment of wishes and provision
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، سَيُؤْتِينَا اللهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّا إِلَى اللهِ رَاغِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ مَالِكُ الْمُلْكِ وَأَنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَمَا تَشَاءُ مِنْ أَمْرٍ يَكُونُ، أَنْ تَقُولَ لِأُمْنِيَّتِي كُنْ لِيَكُونَ عَاجِلًا وَتُغَيِّرَ حَالِي لِأَفْضَلِ حَالٍ، رَبِّ افْتَحْ لِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَارْزُقْنِي رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا مُبَارَكًا عَاجِلًا يَا كَرِيمُ يَا رَبُّ
transliteration: Subhanallah, sayu'tinallahu min fadlihi inna ilallahi raghibun. Allahumma inni as'aluka bi'annaka malikul-mulki wa annaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir wa ma tasha'u min amrin yakun, an taqula li'umniyyati kun liyakuna 'ajilan wa tughayyira hali li'afdali hal, rabbiftah li birahmatika kulla shay'in warzuqni rizqan wasi'an mubarakan 'ajilan ya karimu ya rabb.
translation: Glory be to Allah. Allah will grant us out of His bounty. To Allah alone we turn with hope. O Allah, I ask You by virtue of You being the Master of the Kingdom and that You are capable of all things and whatever You will comes to be, that You say to my wish 'Be' so it manifests quickly, and that You change my state to the best state. My Lord, open for me everything by Your mercy and provide for me a vast, blessed, and immediate provision, O Most Generous, O Lord.
source: A general supplication combining parts of Qur'an 9:59.

name: Du'a for your children from the Qur'an: Surah Al-Furqan (74)
arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنࣲ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa dhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa
translation: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil)

name: Du'a for your children from the Qur'an: Surah Ali 'Imran (38)
arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةࣰ طَيِّبَةًۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee mil ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka Samee'ud-du'aa'
translation: My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer

name: Du'a for your children from the Qur'an: Surah Ibrahim (40)
arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbi Ajaalney Moqeema Al Salati Wa Men Dhoriyatey Rabbana WaTaqabal Duaa
translation: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer

name: Du'a for your children from the Qur'an: Surah Al-Ahqaf (15)
arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحࣰا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِيٓۖ إِنِّي تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa aslih lee fee dhurriyyatee, innee tubtu ilayka wa innee minal muslimeen
translation: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee)

name: Du'a for children's righteousness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِمْ، وَوَفِّقْهُمْ لِطَاعَتِكَ، وَارْزُقْنِي بِرَّهُمْ
transliteration: Allahumma barik li fihim, wa waffiqhum lita'atik, warzuqni birrahum
translation: O Allah, bless them for me, grant them success in Your obedience, and grant me their righteousness.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for children's devotion
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلْ قَلْبَهُمْ بِحُبِّكَ، وَلِسَانَهُمْ بِذِكْرِكَ، وَبَدَنَهُمْ بِطَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahummash-ghal qalbahum bihubbik, wa lisanahum bidhikrik, wa badanahum bita'atik
translation: O Allah, occupy their hearts with Your love, their tongues with Your remembrance, and their bodies with Your obedience.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for children's heart via Qur'an
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبِيعَ قُلُوبِ أَوْلَادِي، وَشِفَاءَ صُدُورِهِمْ، وَنُورًا لِأَبْصَارِهِمْ
transliteration: Allahumma-j'alil-Qur'anal-'adhima rabi'a qulubi awladi, wa shifa'a sudurihim, wa nuran li'absarihim
translation: O Allah, make the Great Qur'an the spring of my children's hearts, the healing of their chests, and a light for their sight.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Musnad Aḥmad 3712.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Musnad Aḥmad 3712)

name: Du'a for children's success and long life
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ أَمْرَهُمْ، وَوَفِّقْهُمْ فِي حَيَاتِهِمْ، اللَّهُمَّ أَمْدِدْ فِي عُمْرِهِمْ بِالصِّحَّةِ وَالْعَافِيَةِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ وَرِضَاكَ
transliteration: Allahumma yassir amrahum, wa waffiqhum fi hayatihim, Allahumma amdid fi 'umrihim bis-sihhati wal-'afiyati fi ta'atika wa ridak
translation: O Allah, ease their affairs and grant them success in their lives. O Allah, extend their lives with health and well-being in Your obedience and pleasure.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for children's health
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِهِمْ فِي بَدَنِهِمْ، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِهِمْ فِي سَمْعِهِمْ، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِهِمْ فِي بَصَرِهِمْ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma 'afihim fi badanihim, Allahumma 'afihim fi sam'ihim, Allahumma 'afihim fi basarihim, la ilaha illa ant
translation: O Allah, grant them well-being in their bodies. O Allah, grant them well-being in their hearing. O Allah, grant them well-being in their sight. There is no deity but You.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5090.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5090)

name: Du'a for children's purity
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ ذَنْبَهُمْ، وَطَهِّرْ قَلْبَهُمْ، وَحَصِّنْ فَرْجَهُمْ
transliteration: Allahummaghfir dhanbahum, wa tahhir qalbahum, wa hassin farjahum
translation: O Allah, forgive their sins, purify their hearts, and protect their chastity.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Musnad Aḥmad 22211.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Musnad Aḥmad 22211)

name: Du'a for children's affairs
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ أَمْرَهُمْ وَوَفِّقْهُمْ فِي حَيَاتِهِمْ
transliteration: Allahumma yassir amrahum wa waffiqhum fi hayatihim
translation: O Allah, ease their affairs and grant them success in their lives.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for children's faith and guidance
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْهِمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ، وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْهِمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ، وَاجْعَلْهُمْ مِنَ الرَّاشِدِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma habbib ilayhimul-iman, wa zayyinhu fi qulubihim, wa karrih ilayhimul-kufra wal-fusuqa wal-'isyan, waj'alhum minar-rashidin
translation: O Allah, endear faith to them and beautify it in their hearts, and make disbelief, defiance, and disobedience hateful to them, and make them among the rightly guided.
source: A general supplication adapting phrasing from the Qur'an (49:7).

name: Du'a for children: knowledge, forbearance, piety, and well-being
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِهِمْ بِالْعِلْمِ، وَزَيِّنْهُمْ بِالْحِلْمِ، وَأَكْرِمْهُمْ بِالتَّقْوَى، وَجَمِّلْهُمْ بِالْعَافِيَةِ
transliteration: Allāhumma aghnihim bil-'ilmi, wa zayyinhum bil-ḥilmi, wa akrimhum bit-taqwā, wa jammilhum bil-'āfiyah
translation: O Allah, enrich them with knowledge, adorn them with forbearance, honour them with piety, and beautify them with well-being.
source: Not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Adapted into the plural from a supplication attributed to Mālik ibn Dīnār.

name: Du'a for children's beneficial knowledge
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْهُمْ بِمَا عَلَّمْتَهُمْ، وَعَلِّمْهُمْ مَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ، وَزِدْهُمْ عِلْمًا
transliteration: Allahumman-fa'hum bima 'allamtahum, wa 'allimhum ma yanfa'uhum, wa zidhum 'ilma
translation: O Allah, benefit them with what You have taught them, teach them what will benefit them, and increase them in knowledge.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3599.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3599)

name: Du'a for children's love of Allah
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْهُمْ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَحُبَّ كُلِّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ، وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُهُمْ إِلَى حُبِّكَ
transliteration: Allahummar-zuqhum hubbak, wa hubba nabiyyika Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa hubba kulli man yuhibbuk, wa hubba 'amalin yuqarribuhum ila hubbik
translation: O Allah, grant them Your love, the love of Your Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), the love of everyone who loves You, and the love of deeds that bring them closer to Your love.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3490.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3490)

name: Du'a for children's complete relief
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لَهُمْ ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ، وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ، وَلَا دَيْنًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهُ، وَلَا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma la tada' lahum dhanban illa ghafartah, wa la hamman illa farrajtah, wa la daynan illa qadaytah, wa la hajatan min hawa'ijid-dunya wal-akhirati illa qadaytaha ya arhamar-rahimin
translation: O Allah, do not leave for them a sin except that You forgive it, nor a sorrow except that You relieve it, nor a debt except that You settle it, nor a need from the needs of this world and the Hereafter except that You fulfill it, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3222.
grading: Ḍaʿīf in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3222)

name: Du'a for children's independence from the unlawful
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِهِمْ بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِهِمْ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummak-fihim bihalalika 'an haramik, wa aghnihim bifadlika 'amman siwak
translation: O Allah, suffice them with Your lawful against Your prohibited, and make them independent of all those besides You by Your bounty.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3563.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3563)

name: Du'a for children's best manners
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِهِمْ لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ، لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahummah-dihim li'ahsanil-akhlaq, la yahdi li'ahsaniha illa ant, wasrif 'anhum sayyi'aha, la yasrifu 'anhum sayyi'aha illa ant
translation: O Allah, guide them to the best of manners, for none guides to the best of them except You. And turn away from them evil manners, for none turns them away except You.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 771a.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 771a)

name: Du'a for children's beautiful character
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقَهُمْ فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقَهُمْ
transliteration: Allahumma kama ahsanta khalqahum fa'ahsin khuluqahum
translation: O Allah, just as You have made their physical form beautiful, make their character beautiful.
source: Adapted into the plural for children from Musnad Aḥmad 24392.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Musnad Aḥmad 24392)

name: Du'a for children's protection
arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
transliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
translation: I seek protection for you both in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous pest, and from every envious blameworthy eye.

name: Names of Allah 1-11
arabic: الرَّحْمَنُ، الرَّحِيمُ، الْمَلِكُ، الْقُدُّوسُ، السَّلاَمُ، الْمُؤْمِنُ، الْمُهَيْمِنُ، الْعَزِيزُ، الْجَبَّارُ، الْمُتَكَبِّرُ، الْخَالِقُ
transliteration: Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim, Al-Malik, Al-Quddus, As-Salam, Al-Mu'min, Al-Muhaymin, Al-Aziz, Al-Jabbar, Al-Mutakabbir, Al-Khaliq
translation: The Beneficent, The Merciful, The Sovereign, The Holy, The Source of Peace, The Granter of Security, The Guardian, The Almighty, The Compeller, The Majestic, The Creator
source: The principle that Allah has ninety-nine names is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration follows the list in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3507 (ḍaʿīf).
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Names of Allah 12-23
arabic: الْبَارِئُ، الْمُصَوِّرُ، الْغَفَّارُ، الْقَهَّارُ، الْوَهَّابُ، الرَّزَّاقُ، الْفَتَّاحُ، الْعَلِيمُ، الْقَابِضُ، الْبَاسِطُ، الْخَافِضُ، الرَّافِعُ
transliteration: Al-Bari, Al-Musawwir, Al-Ghaffar, Al-Qahhar, Al-Wahhab, Ar-Razzaq, Al-Fattah, Al-Alim, Al-Qabid, Al-Basit, Al-Khafid, Ar-Rafi
translation: The Maker, The Fashioner, The Forgiver, The Subduer, The Bestower, The Provider, The Opener, The All-Knowing, The Withholder, The Expander, The Abaser, The Exalter
source: The principle that Allah has ninety-nine names is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration follows the list in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3507 (ḍaʿīf).
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Names of Allah 24-35
arabic: الْمُعِزُّ، الْمُذِلُّ، السَّمِيعُ، الْبَصِيرُ، الْحَكَمُ، الْعَدْلُ، اللَّطِيفُ، الْخَبِيرُ، الْحَلِيمُ، الْعَظِيمُ، الْغَفُورُ، الشَّكُورُ
transliteration: Al-Mu'izz, Al-Mudhill, As-Samee', Al-Baseer, Al-Hakam, Al-'Adl, Al-Lateef, Al-Khabeer, Al-Haleem, Al-'Adheem, Al-Ghafoor, Ash-Shakoor
translation: The Honourer, The Dishonourer, The All-Hearing, The All-Seeing, The Impartial Judge, The Utterly Just, The Subtle One, The All-Aware, The Most Forbearing, The Magnificent, The Great Forgiver, The Rewarder
source: The principle that Allah has ninety-nine names is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration follows the list in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3507 (ḍaʿīf).
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Names of Allah 36-47
arabic: الْعَلِيُّ، الْكَبِيرُ، الْحَفِيظُ، الْمُقِيتُ، الْحَسِيبُ، الْجَلِيلُ، الْكَرِيمُ، الرَّقِيبُ، الْمُجِيبُ، الْوَاسِعُ، الْحَكِيمُ، الْوَدُودُ
transliteration: Al-'Aliyy, Al-Kabeer, Al-Hafeedh, Al-Muqeet, Al-Haseeb, Al-Jaleel, Al-Kareem, Ar-Raqeeb, Al-Mujeeb, Al-Waasi', Al-Hakeem, Al-Wadood
translation: The Most High, The Exalted, The Preserver, The Sustainer, The Reckoner, The Majestic, The Most Generous, The Watchful, The Responsive, The All-Encompassing, The All-Wise, The Most Loving
source: The principle that Allah has ninety-nine names is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration follows the list in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3507 (ḍaʿīf).
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Names of Allah 48-59
arabic: الْمَجِيدُ، الْبَاعِثُ، الشَّهِيدُ، الْحَقُّ، الْوَكِيلُ، الْقَوِيُّ، الْمَتِينُ، الْوَلِيُّ، الْحَمِيدُ، الْمُحْصِي، الْمُبْدِئُ، الْمُعِيدُ
transliteration: Al-Majeed, Al-Baa'ith, Ash-Shaheed, Al-Haqq, Al-Wakeel, Al-Qawiyy, Al-Mateen, Al-Waliyy, Al-Hameed, Al-Muhsee, Al-Mubdi', Al-Mu'eed
translation: The Glorious, The Infuser of New Life, The All-Observing Witness, The Absolute Truth, The Trustee, The All-Strong, The Firm, The Protecting Associate, The Praiseworthy, The All-Enumerating, The Originator, The Restorer
source: The principle that Allah has ninety-nine names is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration follows the list in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3507 (ḍaʿīf).
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Names of Allah 60-71
arabic: الْمُحْيِي، الْمُمِيتُ، الْحَيُّ، الْقَيُّومُ، الْوَاجِدُ، الْمَاجِدُ، الْوَاحِدُ، الْأَحَدُ، الصَّمَدُ، الْقَادِرُ، الْمُقْتَدِرُ، الْمُقَدِّمُ
transliteration: Al-Muhyi, Al-Mumit, Al-Hayy, Al-Qayyum, Al-Wajid, Al-Majid, Al-Wahid, Al-Ahad, As-Samad, Al-Qadir, Al-Muqtadir, Al-Muqaddim
translation: The Giver of Life, The Bringer of Death, The Ever-Living, The Sustainer, The Finder, The Glorious, The One, The Unique, The Eternal, The Capable, The Omnipotent, The Expediter
source: The principle is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration blends lists (such as Sunan Ibn Mājah 3861), incorporating Al-Aḥad which is firmly established as a Name of Allah in the Qur'an (112:1) and Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 7375.
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Names of Allah 72-83
arabic: الْمُؤَخِّرُ، الْأَوَّلُ، الْآخِرُ، الظَّاهِرُ، الْبَاطِنُ، الْوَالِي، الْمُتَعَالِي، الْبَرُّ، التَّوَّابُ، الْمُنْتَقِمُ، الْعَفُوُّ، الرَّءُوفُ
transliteration: Al-Mu'akhkhir, Al-Awwal, Al-Akhir, Az-Zahir, Al-Batin, Al-Wali, Al-Muta'ali, Al-Barr, At-Tawwab, Al-Muntaqim, Al-Afuww, Ar-Ra'uf
translation: The Delayer, The First, The Last, The Manifest, The Hidden, The Governor, The Most Exalted, The Source of Goodness, The Acceptor of Repentance, The Avenger, The Pardoner, The Most Kind
source: The principle that Allah has ninety-nine names is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration follows the list in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3507 (ḍaʿīf).
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Names of Allah 84-93
arabic: مَالِكُ الْمُلْكِ، ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، الْمُقْسِطُ، الْجَامِعُ، الْغَنِيُّ، الْمُغْنِي، الْمَانِعُ، الضَّارُّ، النَّافِعُ، النُّورُ
transliteration: Maalik-ul-Mulk, Dhul-Jalaali Wal-Ikraam, Al-Muqsit, Al-Jaami', Al-Ghaniyy, Al-Mughni, Al-Maani', Ad-Daarr, An-Naafi', An-Noor
translation: Master of the Kingdom, Possessor of Glory and Honour, The Just One, The Gatherer, The Self-Sufficient, The Enricher, The Withholder, The Distresser, The Propitious, The Light
source: The principle that Allah has ninety-nine names is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration follows the list in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3507 (ḍaʿīf).
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Names of Allah 94-99
arabic: الْهَادِي، الْبَدِيعُ، الْبَاقِي، الْوَارِثُ، الرَّشِيدُ، الصَّبُورُ
transliteration: Al-Hadi, Al-Badi, Al-Baqi, Al-Warith, Ar-Rashid, As-Sabur
translation: The Guide, The Incomparable, The Everlasting, The Inheritor, The Guide to the Right Path, The Patient
source: The principle that Allah has ninety-nine names is established in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2736. This specific enumeration follows the list in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3507 (ḍaʿīf).
grading: Ḍaʿīf (the specific enumeration is graded weak as an interpolation/mudraj)

name: Du'a for a mother's long life
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَمْدِدْ فِي عُمْرِ أُمِّي بِالصِّحَّةِ وَالْعَافِيَةِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ وَرِضَاكَ
transliteration: Allahumma amdid fi 'umri ummi bis-sihhati wal-'afiyati fi ta'atika wa ridak
translation: O Allah, extend my mother's life with health and well-being in Your obedience and pleasure.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's health and well-being
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْ أُمِّي الصِّحَّةَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ
transliteration: Allahummar-zuq ummis-sihhata wal-'afiyah
translation: O Allah, grant my mother health and well-being.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's devotion
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا مِنَ الذَّاكِرِينَ لَكَ وَالشَّاكِرِينَ لَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma-j'alha min adh-dhakirina laka wash-shakirina lak
translation: O Allah, make her among those who remember You and are thankful to You.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's relief
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ لَهَا ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ، وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لَهَا حَاجَةً عِنْدَ أَحَدٍ غَيْرِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma la taj'al laha dhanban illa ghafartah, wa la hamman illa farrajtah, Allahumma wa la taj'al laha hajatan 'inda ahadin ghayrak
translation: O Allah, do not leave for her any sin except that You forgive it, nor any sorrow except that You relieve it. O Allah, do not make her in need of anyone other than You.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3222.
grading: Ḍaʿīf in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3222)

name: Du'a to direct a mother's heart
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قَلْبَهَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma Musarrifal-qulub, sarrif qalbaha 'ala ta'atik
translation: O Allah, Turner of the hearts, direct her heart to Your obedience.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2654.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2654)

name: Du'a for a mother's mercy via Qur'an
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْ أُمِّي بِالْقُرْآنِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَهَا نُورًا وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً
transliteration: Allahummar-ham ummi bil-Qur'an, waj'alhu laha nuran wa hudan wa rahmah
translation: O Allah, have mercy on my mother by the Qur'an, and make it a light, guidance, and mercy for her.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's heart
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِهَا، وَشِفَاءَ صَدْرِهَا، وَنُورًا لِبَصَرِهَا
transliteration: Allahumma-j'alil-Qur'anal-'adhima rabi'a qalbiha, wa shifa'a sadriha, wa nuran libasariha
translation: O Allah, make the Great Qur'an the spring of her heart, the healing of her chest, and a light for her sight.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Musnad Aḥmad 3712.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Musnad Aḥmad 3712)

name: Du'a for a mother's obedience
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلْ قَلْبَهَا بِحُبِّكَ، وَلِسَانَهَا بِذِكْرِكَ، وَبَدَنَهَا بِطَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahummash-ghal qalbaha bihubbik, wa lisanaha bidhikrik, wa badanaha bita'atik
translation: O Allah, occupy her heart with Your love, her tongue with Your remembrance, and her body with Your obedience.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for your mother
arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ
transliteration: Rabbigh-fir lee wa li-waalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaat
translation: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women

name: Du'a for a mother's well-being
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَاهْدِهَا وَعَافِهَا وَارْزُقْهَا وَاجْبُرْهَا وَارْفَعْهَا
transliteration: Allahummaghfir laha warhamha wahdiha wa 'afiha warzuqha wajburha warfa'ha
translation: O Allah, forgive her, have mercy on her, guide her, heal her, provide for her, console her, and elevate her.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2697.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2697)

name: Du'a for a mother's forgiveness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا ذَنْبَهَا كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
transliteration: Allahummaghfir laha dhanbaha kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrahu
translation: O Allah, forgive all of her sins, the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 483.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 483)

name: Du'a for a mother's provision
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا ذَنْبَهَا، وَوَسِّعْ لَهَا فِي دَارِهَا، وَبَارِكْ لَهَا فِي رِزْقِهَا
transliteration: Allahummaghfir laha dhanbaha, wa wassi' laha fi dariha, wa barik laha fi rizqiha
translation: O Allah, forgive her sins, expand her home for her, and bless her provision.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3500.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3500)

name: Du'a for a mother's independence from the unlawful
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِهَا بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِهَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummak-fiha bihalalika 'an haramik, wa aghniha bifadlika 'amman siwak
translation: O Allah, suffice her with Your lawful against Your prohibited, and make her independent of all those besides You by Your bounty.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3563.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3563)

name: Du'a for a mother's Paradise
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْ أُمِّي الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرُبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ وَعَمَلٍ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرُبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ وَعَمَلٍ
transliteration: Allahummar-zuq ummil-jannata wa ma qaruba ilayha min qawlin wa 'amal, wa ba'id baynaha wa baynan-nari wa ma qaruba ilayha min qawlin wa 'amal
translation: O Allah, grant my mother Paradise and whatever words or actions bring her near to it, and distance her from the Hellfire and whatever words or actions bring her near to it.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Sunan Ibn Mājah 3846.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan Ibn Mājah 3846)

name: Du'a to guide a mother among the guided
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ أُمِّي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِهَا فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ
transliteration: Allahummahdi ummi fiman hadayt, wa 'afiha fiman 'afayt
translation: O Allah, guide my mother among those You have guided, and grant her well-being among those You have granted well-being.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 464 (Qunūt du'a).
grading: Ḥasan Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 464)

name: Du'a for a mother's success
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْ أُمِّي لِهُدَاكَ، وَاجْعَلْ عَمَلَهَا فِي رِضَاكَ
transliteration: Allahumma waffiq ummi lihudak, waj'al 'amalaha fi ridak
translation: O Allah, grant my mother success in following Your guidance, and make her deeds pleasing to You.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's repentance
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ تَوْبَتَهَا، وَأَجِبْ دَعْوَتَهَا
transliteration: Allahumma taqabbal tawbataha, wa ajib da'wataha
translation: O Allah, accept her repentance and answer her supplication.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3551.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3551)

name: Du'a for dutifulness to a mother
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى بِرِّهَا حَتَّى تَرْضَى عَنِّي
transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala birriha hatta tarda 'anni
translation: O Allah, help me to be dutiful to her until she is pleased with me.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's light
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَهَا فِي قَلْبِهَا نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِهَا نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِهَا نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِهَا نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِهَا نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِهَا نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِهَا نُورًا، وَمِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهَا نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِهَا نُورًا
transliteration: Allahumma-j'al laha fi qalbiha nura, wa fi lisaniha nura, wa fi sam'iha nura, wa fi basariha nura, wa min tahtiha nura, wa 'an yaminiha nura, wa 'an shimaliha nura, wa min bayni yadayha nura, wa min khalfiha nura
translation: O Allah, place light in her heart, light on her tongue, light in her hearing, light in her sight, light beneath her, light on her right, light on her left, light before her, and light behind her.
source: Adapted into the third person feminine from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 763.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 763)

name: Du'a for a mother's remembrance
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوْقَاتَهَا بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً
transliteration: Allahumma-j'al awqataha bidhikrika ma'murah
translation: O Allah, make her time filled with Your remembrance.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's protection
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ أَثْمَنَ مَا عِنْدِي وَأَقْرَبَهَا إِلَى قَلْبِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْ لِي أُمِّي وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْحَافِظِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni astawdi'uka athmana ma 'indi wa aqrabaha ila qalbi, Allahummah-fadh li ummi wa anta khayrul-hafizhin
translation: O Allah, I entrust to You the most precious thing I have and the closest to my heart. O Allah, protect my mother for me, for You are the best of protectors.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's happiness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْعِدْ قَلْبَ أُمِّي، وَاشْرَحْ صَدْرَهَا، وَأَرِحْ قَلْبَهَا، وَأَبْعِدْ عَنْهَا كُلَّ مَا يُحْزِنُهَا، وَأَطِلْ عُمْرَهَا
transliteration: Allahumma as'id qalba ummi, washrah sadraha, wa arih qalbaha, wa ab'id 'anha kulla ma yuhzinuha, wa atil 'umraha
translation: O Allah, bring happiness to my mother's heart, expand her chest, comfort her heart, keep away from her all that saddens her, and prolong her life.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a mother's protection from sickness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَبْعِدْ عَنْهَا الْمَرَضَ، وَارْزُقْهَا طُولَ الْعُمْرِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma ab'id 'anhal-marad, warzuqha tulal-'umri fi ta'atik
translation: O Allah, keep sickness away from her, and grant her a long life in Your obedience.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Ayat al-Kursi
arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةࣱ وَلَا نَوۡمࣱۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءࣲ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
transliteration: Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa huwal haiyul qai-yoom laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa laa nawm; lahoo maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard man zallazee yashfa’u indahooo illaa be iznih ya’lamu maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona beshai ‘immin ‘ilmihee illa be maa sha  wasi’a kursiyyuhus samaa waati wal arda wa la ya’ooduho hifzuhumaa wa huwal aliyyul ‘azeem
translation: Allah! There is no God save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous

name: Surah Al-Ikhlas (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul Huwallaahu Ahad, Allaahus-Samad, lam yalid wa lam yoolad, wa lam yakul lahu kufuwan ahad
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: He is Allah, the One Allah, the eternally Besought of all He begetteth not nor was begotten And there is none comparable unto Him

name: Surah Al-Falaq (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbil-falaq, min sharri maa khalaq, wa min sharri ghaasiqin idhaa waqab, wa min sharrin-naffaathaati fil-'uqad, wa min sharri haasidin idhaa hasad
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak From the evil of that which He created From the evil of the darkness when it is intense And from the evil of malignant witchcraft And from the evil of the envier when he envieth

name: Surah An-Nas (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbin-naas, Malikin-naas, Ilaahin-naas, min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas, alladhee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas, minal-jinnati wan-naas
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind The King of mankind The God of mankind From the evil of the sneaking whisperer Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind Of the jinn and of mankind

name: Morning adhkar: We have entered a new day and with it all dominion is Allah's
arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
transliteration: Asbahnaa wa 'asbahal-mulku lillaah walhamdu lillaah, laa 'ilaaha 'illaAllaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamd wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi 'as'aluka khayra maa fee haathal-yawm wa khayra maa ba'dah wa 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa fee haathal-yawm wa sharri maa ba'dah, Rabbi 'a'oothu bika minal-kasal, wa soo'il-kibari, Rabbi 'a'oothu bika min 'athaabin fin-naari wa 'athaabin fil-qabri.
translation: We have entered a new day and with it all dominion is Allah's. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him is the praise and He is Able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this day and of the days that come after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and of the days that come after it.  My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and helpless old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell-fire  and from the punishment of the grave.

name: Morning adhkar: O Allah, by You we enter the morning
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Allaahumma bika 'asbahnaa, wa bika 'amsaynaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namoot wa 'ilaykan-nushoor
translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

name: Morning adhkar: O Allah, You are my Lord
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِر لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allaahumma 'Anta Rabbee laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta, khalaqtanee wa 'anaa 'abduk, wa 'anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-tata't, 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa sana't, 'aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa 'aboo'u bithanbee faghfir lee fa'innahu laa yaghfiruth-thunooba 'illaa 'Anta.
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You. You created me and I am your slave. I keep Your covenant, and my pledge to You so far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to Your blessings upon me, and I admit to my misdeeds. Forgive me, for there is none who may forgive sins but You.

name: Morning adhkar (four times): O Allah, I have entered a new morning
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
