transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'asbahtu 'ush-hiduk wa 'ush-hidu hamalata 'arshik, wa malaa'ikataka wajamee'a khalqik, 'annaka 'Antallaah laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta wahdaka laa shareeka lak, wa 'anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa Rasooluk
translation: O Allah, I have entered a new morning  and call upon You and upon the bearers of Your Throne, upon Your angels and all creation to bear witness that surely You are Allah, there is none worthy of worship but You alone, You have no partners, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5069 (ḥasan according to Ibn Bāz; ḍaʿīf according to al-Albānī)

name: Morning adhkar: O Allah, whatever blessing has been received by me
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
transliteration: Allaahumma maa 'asbaha bee min ni'amatin 'aw bi'ahadin min khalqik faminka wahdaka laa shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr
translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has been received by me or anyone of Your creation is from You alone, You have no partner. All praise is for you and thanks is to You.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5073, Ṣaḥīḥ Ibn Ḥibbān 861 (ḥasan according to Ibn Bāz; ḍaʿīf according to al-Albānī)

name: Morning adhkar (three times): O Allah, make me healthy in my body
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant. Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oothu bika minal-kufri, wal-faqr, wa 'a'oothu bika min 'athaabil-qabr, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant.
translation: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You.   O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is none worthy of worship but You.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5090 (ḥasan according to al-Albānī; ḍaʿīf according to al-Arnaʾūṭ)

name: Morning adhkar: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a-uthu bika minal-hammi wal-hazn, wa a-uthu bika minal-ajzi wal-kasal, wa a-uthu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a-uthu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overpowered by debt and the oppression of others.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 1555 (ḍaʿīf; similar duʿāʾ in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6369)

name: Morning adhkar (seven times): Allah sufficeth me
arabic: حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Hasbiyallaahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkalt wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem
translation: Allah sufficeth me. There is no God save Him. In Him have I put my trust, and He is Lord of the Tremendous Throne
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5081 (ṣaḥīḥ mawqūf from Abū ad-Dardāʾ; marfūʿ is ḍaʿīf)

name: Morning adhkar: Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-'afwa wal'aafiyah fid-dunyaa wal'aakhirah, Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-'afwa wal'aafiyah fee deenee wa dunyaaya wa 'ahlee, wa maalee, Allaahum-mastur 'awraatee, wa 'aamin raw'aatee, Allaahum-mahfadhnee min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfee, wa 'an yameenee, wa 'an shimaalee, wa min fawqee, wa 'a'oothu bi'adhamatika 'an 'ughtaala min tahtee
translation: Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in this world and the next. O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. O Allah, conceal my secrets and preserve me from anguish. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, from my right, and from my left, and from above me. I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me

name: Morning adhkar: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّماوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
transliteration: Allaahumma 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaada faatiras-samaawaati wal'ard, Rabba kulli shay'i wa maleekah, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant, 'a'oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkih, wa 'an 'aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo'an, 'aw 'ajurrahu 'ilaa Muslimin
translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident, Maker of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers. (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.

name: Morning adhkar (three times): In the Name of Allah
arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillaahil-lathee laa yadhurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-'ardhi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee 'ul- 'Aleem
translation: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing

name: Morning adhkar (three times): I am pleased with Allah as my Lord
arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيَّاً
transliteration: Radheetu billaahi Rabba, wa bil-'Islaami deena, wa bi-Muhammadin (sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama) Nabiyya
translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as my Prophet
countSource: Sunan at-Tirmidhī 3389 (ḥasan according to Ibn Bāz; ḍaʿīf according to al-Albānī)

name: Morning adhkar: O Ever Living One, O Eternal One
arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom birahmatika 'astagheeth 'aslih lee sha'nee kullahu wa laa takilnee 'ilaa nafsee tarfata 'aynin
translation: O Ever Living One, O Eternal One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all my affairs. Do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment)

name: Morning adhkar: We have entered the morning
arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
transliteration: Asbahnaa wa asbahal-mulku lillaahi Rabbil-'aalameen, Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka khayra haathal-yawm, fathahu wa nasrahu wa noorahu wa barakatahu wa hudaah, wa 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa feehi wa sharri maa ba'dahu.
translation: We have entered the morning and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day: its victory, its help, its light, and its blessings and guidance. I seek Your protection from the evil that is in it and from the evil that follows it.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5084 (ḥasan according to al-Arnaʾūṭ; ḍaʿīf according to al-Albānī)

name: Morning adhkar: We have entered a new day upon the natural religion of Islam
arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
transliteration: Asbahnaa 'alaa fitratil-'Islaam wa 'alaa kalimatil-'ikhlaas, wa 'alaa deeni Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin (sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallem), wa 'alaa millati 'abeenaa 'Ibraaheema, haneefan Musliman wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen.
translation: We have entered a new day upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincere devotion, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and the faith of our father Ibrahim. He was upright (in worshipping Allah), and a Muslim. He was not of those who worship others besides Allah.

name: Morning adhkar (ten times): None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone
arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illallaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise and He is Able to do all things.

name: Morning adhkar (one hundred times): Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih
translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him

name: Morning adhkar (three times): Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih: 'Adada khalqih, wa ridhaa nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih wa midaada kalimaatih.
translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words.

name: Morning adhkar: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka 'ilman naafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted

name: Morning adhkar (one hundred times): I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him
arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: Astaghfirullaaha wa 'atoobu 'ilayh
translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him
countSource: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2702 (100 times across the day; not morning-specific)

name: Morning adhkar (ten times): Oh Allah, we ask you for peace and blessings
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa nabiyyinaa Muhammad
translation: Oh Allah, we ask you for peace and blessings upon our prophet Muhammad   Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Who recites blessings upon me 10 times in the morning and 10 times in the evening will obtain my intercession on the Day of Resurrection." At-Tabrani reported this Hadith
countSource: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 408 (general; 10x morning/evening in aṭ-Ṭabarānī is ḍaʿīf)

name: Ayat al-Kursi
arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةࣱ وَلَا نَوۡمࣱۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءࣲ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
transliteration: Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa huwal haiyul qai-yoom laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa laa nawm; lahoo maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard man zallazee yashfa’u indahooo illaa be iznih ya’lamu maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona beshai ‘immin ‘ilmihee illa be maa sha  wasi’a kursiyyuhus samaa waati wal arda wa la ya’ooduho hifzuhumaa wa huwal aliyyul ‘azeem
translation: Allah! There is no God save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous

name: Surah Al-Ikhlas (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul Huwallaahu Ahad, Allaahus-Samad, lam yalid wa lam yoolad, wa lam yakul lahu kufuwan ahad
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: He is Allah, the One Allah, the eternally Besought of all He begetteth not nor was begotten And there is none comparable unto Him

name: Surah Al-Falaq (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbil-falaq, min sharri maa khalaq, wa min sharri ghaasiqin idhaa waqab, wa min sharrin-naffaathaati fil-'uqad, wa min sharri haasidin idhaa hasad
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak From the evil of that which He created From the evil of the darkness when it is intense And from the evil of malignant witchcraft And from the evil of the envier when he envieth

name: Surah An-Nas (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbin-naas, Malikin-naas, Ilaahin-naas, min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas, alladhee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas, minal-jinnati wan-naas
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind The King of mankind The God of mankind From the evil of the sneaking whisperer Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind Of the jinn and of mankind

name: Evening adhkar: We have entered a new evening and with it all dominion is Allah's
arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
transliteration: Amsaynaa wa amsal-mulku lillaahi walhamdu lillaah, laa 'ilaaha 'illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi 'as'aluka khayra maa fee haathihil-laylati wa khayra maa ba'dahaa wa 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa fee haathihil-laylati wa sharri maa ba'dahaa, Rabbi 'a'oothu bika minal-kasali, wa soo'il-kibar, Rabbi 'a'oothu bika min 'athaabin fin-naari wa 'athaabin fil-qabr.
translation: We have entered a new evening and with it all dominion is Allah's. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him is the praise and He is Able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this evening and of the evenings that come after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this evening and of the evenings that come after it.  My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and helpless old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell-fire  and from the punishment of the grave.

name: Evening adhkar: O Allah, by You we enter the evening
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ
transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsaynā wa bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilayka-l-maṣīr.
translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.

name: Evening adhkar: O Allah, You are my Lord
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allaahumma 'Anta Rabbee laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant, khalaqtanee wa 'anaa 'abduk, wa 'anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-tata't, 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa sana't, 'aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa 'aboo'u bithanbee faghfir lee fa'innahu laa yaghfiruth-thunooba 'illaa 'Anta.
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You. You created me and I am your slave. I keep Your covenant, and my pledge to You so far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to Your blessings upon me, and I admit to my misdeeds. Forgive me, for there is none who may forgive sins but You

name: Evening adhkar (four times): O Allah, I have entered the evening
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ush-hiduk, wa ush-hidu ḥamlata ʿarshik, wa malā’ikatika, wa jamī’a khalqik, annaka Anta-llāhu lā ilāha illā Anta waḥdaka, lā sharīka lak, wa an-na Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk.
translation: O Allah, I have entered the evening and call upon You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all creation, to bear witness that surely You are Allah. There is no god but You Alone. You have no partners, and that Muhammad (peace be upon him) is Your slave and Your Messenger.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5069 (ḥasan according to Ibn Bāz; ḍaʿīf according to al-Albānī)

name: Evening adhkar: O Allah, all the favours that I or anyone from Your creation has received
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqik, fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa laka-l-ḥamdu wa laka-sh-shukr.
translation: O Allah, all the favours that I or anyone from Your creation has received in the evening, are from You Alone. You have no partner. To You Alone belong all praise and all thanks.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5073, Ṣaḥīḥ Ibn Ḥibbān 861 (ḥasan according to Ibn Bāz; ḍaʿīf according to al-Albānī)

name: Evening adhkar (three times): O Allah, make me healthy in my body
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant. Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oothu bika minal-kufri, wal-faqr, wa 'a'oothu bika min 'athaabil-qabr, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant.
translation: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You.   O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is none worthy of worship but You.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5090 (ḥasan according to al-Albānī; ḍaʿīf according to al-Arnaʾūṭ)

name: Evening adhkar: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a-uthu bika minal-hammi wal-huzn, wa a-uthu bika minal-ajzi wal-kasal, wa a-uthu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a-udhu bika min galabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overpowered by debt and the oppression of others.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 1555 (ḍaʿīf; similar duʿāʾ in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6369)

name: Evening adhkar (seven times): Allah sufficeth me
arabic: حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Hasbiyallaahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkalt wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem
translation: Allah sufficeth me. There is no God save Him. In Him have I put my trust, and He is Lord of the Tremendous Throne
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5081 (ṣaḥīḥ mawqūf from Abū ad-Dardāʾ; marfūʿ is ḍaʿīf)

name: Evening adhkar: Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-'afwa wal'aafiyah fid-dunyaa wal'aakhirah, Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-'afwa wal'aafiyah fee deenee wa dunyaaya wa 'ahlee, wa maalee, Allaahum-mastur 'awraatee, wa 'aamin raw'aatee, Allaahum-mahfadhnee min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfee, wa 'an yameenee, wa 'an shimaalee, wa min fawqee, wa 'a'oothu bi'adhamatika 'an 'ughtaala min tahtee
translation: Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in this world and the next. O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. O Allah, conceal my secrets and preserve me from anguish. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, from my right, and from my left, and from above me. I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me

name: Evening adhkar: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّماوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
transliteration: Allaahumma 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadah faatiras-samaawaati wal'ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekah, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant, 'a'oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkih, wa 'an 'aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo'an, 'aw 'ajurrahu 'ilaa Muslimin
translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident, Maker of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers. (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.

name: Evening adhkar (three times): In the Name of Allah
arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillaahil-lathee laa yadhurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-'ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee 'ul- 'Aleem
translation: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

name: Evening adhkar (three times): I am pleased with Allah as my Lord
arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيَّاً
transliteration: Radheetu billaahi Rabba, wa bil-'Islaami deena, wa bi-Muhammadin (sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama) Nabiyya
translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as my Prophet
countSource: Sunan at-Tirmidhī 3389 (ḥasan according to Ibn Bāz; ḍaʿīf according to al-Albānī)

name: Evening adhkar: O Ever Living One, O Eternal One
arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom birahmatika 'astagheeth 'aslih lee sha'nee kullahu wa laa takilnee 'ilaa nafsee tarfata 'aynin
translation: O Ever Living One, O Eternal One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all my affairs. Do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment)

name: Evening adhkar: We have entered the evening
arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فَتْحَهَا وَنَصْرَهَا وَنُورَهَا وَبَرَكَتَهَا وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
transliteration: Amsaynaa wa amsal-mulku lillaahi Rabbil-'aalameen, Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka khayra haathihil-laylah, fathahaa wa nasrahaa wa noorahaa wa barakatahaa wa hudaahaa, wa 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa feehaa wa sharri maa ba'dahaa.
translation: We have entered the evening and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day/night: its victory, its help, its light, and its blessings and guidance. I seek Your protection from the evil that is in it and from the evil that follows it.
countSource: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5084 (ḥasan according to al-Arnaʾūṭ; ḍaʿīf according to al-Albānī)

name: Evening adhkar: We have entered the evening upon the natural religion of Islam
arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
transliteration: Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭrati-l-islām, wa ʿalā kalimati-l-ikhlāṣ, wa ʿalā dīni Nabiyyinā Muḥammad wa ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfam-muslima, wa mā kāna mina-l-mushrikīn.
translation: We have entered the evening upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of pure faith (i.e. Shahādah), the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and upon the way of our father Ibrāhīm, who turned away from all that is false, having surrendered  to Allah, and he was not of the polytheists.
countSource: Musnad Aḥmad 15360 (ṣaḥīḥ for morning; evening wording in 15563 is ḍaʿīf)

name: Evening adhkar (ten times): None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone
arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illallaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise and He is Able to do all things.

name: Evening adhkar (one hundred times): Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih
translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him

name: Evening adhkar (three times): I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: A'othu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created

name: Evening adhkar (three times): Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih 'Adada khalqih, wa ridhaa nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih wa midaada kalimaatih
translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words
countSource: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2726 (established for morning; no narration establishes evening)

name: Evening adhkar (ten times): Oh Allah, we ask you for peace and blessings
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa nabiyyinaa Muhammad
translation: Oh Allah, we ask you for peace and blessings upon our prophet Muhammad The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Who recites blessings upon me 10 times in the morning and 10 times in the evening will obtain my intercession on the Day of Resurrection." At-Tabrani reported this Hadith
countSource: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 408 (general; 10x morning/evening in aṭ-Ṭabarānī is ḍaʿīf)

name: Du'a of gratitude to Allah
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَلَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ، اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ فِي كُلِّ لَحْظَةٍ أَبَدًا عَدَدَ مَعْلُومَاتِكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَعَلَى سَائِرِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu biyadihil-khayru wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, lahul-asma'ul-husna yusabbihu lahu ma fis-samawati wal-ardi wa huwal-'azizul-hakim. allahumma salli wa sallim fi kulli lahzatin abadan 'adada ma'lumatika 'ala sayyidina muhammadin wa alihi wa sahbihi wa 'ala sa'iril-anbiya'i was-salihina ila yawmid-din.
translation: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and to Him belongs the sovereignty, and to Him belongs all praise. In His hand is all goodness, and He has power over all things. His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise. O Allah, send peace and blessings at every moment forever, to the number of Your knowledge, upon our master Muhammad, his family, his companions, and upon all the prophets and the righteous until the Day of Judgment.
source: A general supplication combining the tahlīl (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 3293, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2691, with "in His hand is all goodness" as in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3428), Qur'an 59:24 and a composed salawat; not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

quran_spans.translation: His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise

name: Du'a using powerful Names of Allah
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ الْحُسْنَى وَكَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّاتِ مَا عَلِمْنَا مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَلِأَحْبَابِنَا أَبَدًا وَلِلْمُسْلِمِينَ كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ، وَتَسْتُرَ لَنَا كُلَّ عَيْبٍ، وَتَكْشِفَ عَنَّا كُلَّ كَرْبٍ، وَتَصْرِفَ وَتَرْفَعَ عَنَّا كُلَّ بَلَاءٍ، وَتُعَافِيَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ مِحْنَةٍ وَفِتْنَةٍ وَشِدَّةٍ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ، وَتَقْضِيَ لَنَا كُلَّ حَاجَةٍ فِيهِمَا، يَا مَنْ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، يَا عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ سُبْحَانَكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْأَعْلَى الْأَعَزِّ الْأَجَلِّ الْأَكْرَمِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ وَالْمَوَاهِبِ الْعِظَامِ
transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka bi asma'ikal husna wa kalimatikat taammati ma 'alimna minha wa ma lam na'lam, an taghfira lana wa li ahbabina abadan wa lil muslimeena kulla dhanb, wa tastura lana kulla 'ayb, wa takshifa 'anna kulla karb, wa tasrifa wa tarfa'a 'anna kulla bala', wa tu'afiyana min kulli mihnatatin wa fitnatin wa shiddatin fid daarayn, wa taqdiya lana kulla hajatin feehima, ya man huwallahul ladhee la ilaha illa huw, ya 'alimal ghaybi wash shahadati subhanaka la ilaha illa ant, ya dhal jalali wal ikram, as'aluka bismikal a'lal a'azzil ajallil akram ya dhal jalali wal ikram wal mawahibil 'idham.
translation: O Allah, we ask You by Your beautiful names and Your perfect words, those we know and those we do not know, to forgive us, our loved ones forever, and all Muslims from every sin. We ask You to cover every defect, relieve every distress, and lift every affliction. Grant us safety from every ordeal, trial, and hardship in both worlds, and fulfill every need in them. O You who are Allah, there is no god but He, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, glory be to You, there is no god but You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor. I ask You by Your Supreme, Most Mighty, Most Majestic, Most Generous Name, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor and great gifts.
source: A general supplication incorporating a fragment from Sunan Ibn Mājah 3846 (ṣaḥīḥ).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Ghaffar
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا غَفَّارُ اغْفِرْ ذُنُوبَنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Ghaffaru ighfir dhunoobana
translation: O Allah, The Great Forgiver, forgive our sins.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Ar-Razzaq
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَزَّاقُ وَسِّعْ أَرْزَاقَنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Razzaqu wassi' arzaqana
translation: O Allah, The Provider, expand our sustenance.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Aleem
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا عَلِيمُ نَوِّرْ بِالْعِلْمِ قُلُوبَنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya 'Aleemu nawwir bil 'ilmi quloobana
translation: O Allah, The All-Knowing, illuminate our hearts with knowledge.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Wakeel
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا وَكِيلُ تَوَكَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ فَاكْفِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Wakeelu tawakkalna 'alayka fakfina
translation: O Allah, The Trustee, we rely on You, so suffice us.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Mumeet
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مُمِيتُ قَدِّرْ مَوْتَنَا عَلَى التَّوْحِيدِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ
transliteration: Allahumma ya Mumeetu qaddir mawtana 'alat tawheedi wal islam
translation: O Allah, The Inflicter of Death, decree our death upon Oneness and Islam.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Waajid
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا وَاجِدُ أَنْتَ الْغَنِيُّ فَأَغْنِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Waajidu antal Ghaniyyu fa'ghnina
translation: O Allah, The Finder, You are the Wealthy, so enrich us.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Qawiyy
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا قَوِيُّ قَوِّ عَزْمَنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Qawiyyu qawwi 'azmana
translation: O Allah, The All-Strong, strengthen our resolve.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Ar-Raqeeb
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَقِيبُ اعْفُ عَنَّا وَعَافِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Raqeebu u'fu 'anna wa 'afina
translation: O Allah, The Watchful, pardon us and grant us well-being.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Mujeeb
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مُجِيبُ يَسِّرْ أُمُورَنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Mujeebu yassir umoorana
translation: O Allah, The Responsive, ease our affairs.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name An-Nafi'
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا نَافِعُ انْفَعْنَا بِأَنْوَارِ دِينِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Nafi'u infa'na bi anwari deenina
translation: O Allah, The Propitious, benefit us with the lights of our religion.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Muhyi
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مُحْيِي بِذِكْرِكَ أَحْيِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Muhyi bi dhikrika ahyina
translation: O Allah, The Giver of Life, give us life through Your remembrance.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name As-Samee'
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا سَمِيعُ اسْمَعْ دُعَاءَنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Samee'u isma' du'a'ana
translation: O Allah, The All-Hearing, hear our supplications.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Baseer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا بَصِيرُ بَصِّرْنَا بِعُيُوبِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Baseeru bassirna bi 'uyoobina
translation: O Allah, The All-Seeing, give us insight into our faults.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Ar-Ra'oof
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَءُوفُ ارْأَفْ بِنَا وَبِإِخْوَانِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Ra'oofu ir'af bina wa bi ikhwanina
translation: O Allah, The Most Kind, be kind to us and our brothers and sisters.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Waahid
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا وَاحِدُ فَرِّجْ كَرْبَنَا وَغَمَّنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Waahidu farrij karbana wa ghammana
translation: O Allah, The One, relieve our anguish and distress.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Maani'
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَانِعُ امْنَعْ كُلَّ كَرْبٍ يُهِمُّنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Maani'u imna' kulla karbin yuhimmuna
translation: O Allah, The Withholder, withhold every hardship that distresses us.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Mu'min
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مُؤْمِنُ ثَبِّتْ إِيمَانَنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Mu'minu thabbit eemanana
translation: O Allah, The Infuser of Faith, strengthen our faith.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Jaleel
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا جَلِيلُ أَنْتَ مَلَاذُنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Jaleelu anta maladhuna
translation: O Allah, The Majestic, You are our sanctuary.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Ghaniyy
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا غَنِيُّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ غَيْرِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma ya Ghaniyyu aghnina 'an ghayrik
translation: O Allah, The Self-Sufficient, make us independent of all besides You.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Qahhar
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا قَهَّارُ اقْهَرْ مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Qahhaaru iqhar man dhalamana
translation: O Allah, The All-Prevailing, prevail over those who have wronged us.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Waasi'
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا وَاسِعُ وَسِّعْ لَنَا الْعِلْمَ وَالْعَطَاءَ
transliteration: Allahumma ya Waasi'u wassi' lanal 'ilma wal 'ataa'
translation: O Allah, The All-Encompassing, increase our knowledge and generosity.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Awwal Al-Akhir
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا أَوَّلُ يَا آخِرُ أَنْتَ فِي الْكُلِّ حَسْبُنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Awwalu ya Aakhiru anta fil kulli hasbuna
translation: O Allah, The First and The Last, You are sufficient for us in everything.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Ar-Rahman
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَحْمَنُ أَغِثْنِي
transliteration: Allahumma ya Rahmanu aghithni
translation: O Allah, The Most Gracious, help me.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name An-Noor
arabic: يَا نُورَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ اجْعَلْ فِي وَجْهِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا أَمْشِي بِهِ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ
transliteration: Ya Nooras samawati wal ardi ij'al fi wajhi noora, wa fi lisani noora, wa fi qalbi noora, wa 'an yameeni noora, wa 'an shimali noora. Allahumma ij'al li nooran amshi bihi baynan naas.
translation: O Light of the heavens and the earth, place light in my face, light in my tongue, light in my heart, light on my right, and light on my left. O Allah, grant me a light by which I walk among people.
source: A general supplication heavily adapting the Prophetic supplication of light recorded in Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 763, alongside Qur'anic phrasing.

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Haadi
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا هَادِي اهْدِنَا لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma ya Haadi ihdina li ahsanil akhlaaqi la yahdi li ahsaniha illa ant
translation: O Allah, The Guide, guide us to the best of manners, for none guides to the best of them except You.
source: Adapted in the plural for group supplication and addressed to "Yā Hādī" from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 771, which reads "ihdinī" (guide me).
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 771)

name: Du'a using Allah's Name As-Samad
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا صَمَدُ يَا مَنْ يَقْضِي حَوَائِجَ النَّاسِ اقْضِ حَوَائِجَنَا وَحَقِّقْ أَمَانِيَّنَا وَفَرِّجْ كُرُبَاتِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma ya Samadu ya man yaqdee hawa'ijan naasi iqdi hawa'ijana wa haqqiq amaniyyana wa farrij kurubaatina
translation: O Allah, The Eternal, O You who satisfies the needs of people, satisfy our needs, grant our wishes, and ease our hardships.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Qaadir
arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا قَادِرُ يَا قَدِيرُ يَا مُقْتَدِرُ أَرِنِي عَجَائِبَ قُدْرَتِكَ فِيمَا أَتَمَنَّى
transliteration: Ya Allahu ya Qaadiru ya Qadeeru ya Muqtadiru arini 'aja'iba qudratika feema atamanna
translation: O Allah, The Capable, The All-Powerful, The Omnipotent, show me the wonders of Your power in what I wish for.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-'Afuww
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا عَفُوُّ اعْفُ عَنَّا وَعَافِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
transliteration: Allahumma ya 'Afuwwu u'fu 'anna wa 'afina fid dunya wal aakhirah
translation: O Allah, The Pardoner, pardon us and grant us well-being in this life and the Hereafter.
source: A general supplication expanding upon the framework of Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3513 (ṣaḥīḥ) with additional composed phrasing.

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Qaabid Al-Baasit
arabic: يَا قَابِضُ يَا بَاسِطُ اقْبِضْ عَنِّي كُلَّ شَرٍّ وَمَعْصِيَةٍ وَابْسُطْ لِي مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَأُمْنِيَّةٍ، اقْبِضْ عَنِّي سَاعَاتِ الْأَلَمِ وَابْسُطْ لِي سَاعَاتِ الْفَرَحِ، اقْبِضْ عَنِّي أَصْحَابَ السُّوءِ وَابْسُطْ لِي صُحْبَةَ الْخَيْرِ، وَاقْبِضْ عَنِّي الْكَرْبَ وَالْهَمَّ وَالْغَمَّ وَابْسُطْ لِي الْأَمَلَ وَالْبِشْرَ
transliteration: Ya Qaabidu ya Baasitu iqbid 'anni kulla sharrin wa ma'siyatin wabsut li min kulli khayrin wa umniyyah, iqbid 'anni saa'aatil alami wabsut li saa'aatil farah, iqbid 'anni ashaabas soo'i wabsut li suhbatal khayr, waqbid 'annil karba wal hamma wal ghamma wabsut lil amala wal bishr.
translation: O Allah, The Withholder, The Extender, withhold from me all evil and disobedience, and extend to me every goodness and wish. Withhold from me hours of pain and extend to me hours of joy. Withhold from me bad companions and extend to me righteous companionship. Withhold from me distress, worry, and sadness, and extend to me hope and glad tidings.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Qareeb
arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْقَرِيبِ أَنْ تُقَرِّبَنَا لَكَ وَتُحَبِّبَنَا فِي طَاعَتِكَ وَتُقَرِّبَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: As'aluka bismikal qareebi an tuqarribana laka wa tuhabbibana fi ta'atika wa tuqarriba baynana wa baynas saaliheena min 'ibadika ya arhamar rahimeen
translation: I ask You by Your name The Near, to bring us closer to You, make us love obeying You, and bring us closer to the righteous among Your servants, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Wadood
arabic: يَا وَدُودُ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي حُبًّا وَوُدًّا عَظِيمًا لَكَ وَاكْتُبْنِي مِمَّنْ تَوَدُّهُمْ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَاجْعَلْنِي وَدُودًا لِخَلْقِكَ حَتَّى تُحِبَّنِي النَّاسُ
transliteration: Ya Wadoodu ij'al fi qalbi hubban wa wuddan 'adheeman laka waktubni mimman tawadduhum min 'ibadika waj'alni wadoodan likhalqika hatta tuhibbanin naas
translation: O Allah, The Most Loving, place immense love and affection in my heart for You, and record me among the servants You love. Make me loving toward Your creation so that people may love me.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a of reliance on Al-Wakeel
arabic: يَا وَكِيلُ يَا رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ عَلَيْكَ فِي حَيَاتِي كُلِّهَا وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَلَا أَقَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَيْكَ فَلَا تَتْرُكْنِي يَا وَكِيلِي
transliteration: Ya Wakeelu ya rabbi ij'alni minal mutawakileena 'alayka fi hayati kulliha wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'aynin wa la aqalla min dhalika tawakkaltu 'alayka fala tatrukni ya wakeeli
translation: O Allah, The Trustee, O Lord, make me among those who rely entirely on You in all my life. Do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye, nor for anything less. I rely on You, so do not abandon me, O my Trustee.
source: A general supplication incorporating the exact phrasing "wa-lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn" from Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5090 (ḥasan).

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Waliyy
arabic: يَا وَلِيُّ تَوَلَّ أَمْرِي، تَوَلَّنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ، تَوَلَّنِي بِهِدَايَتِكَ، تَوَلَّنِي حَتَّى يَمْلَأَنِي الْأَمَانُ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، فَأَنْتَ الْقَائِلُ: أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
transliteration: Ya Waliyyu tawalla amri, tawallani birahmatika, tawallani bihidayatika, tawallani hatta yamla'anil amanu minad dunya wal aakhirah, fa antal qa'il: Ala inna awliya'allahi la khawfun 'alayhim wa la hum yahzanoon.
translation: O Allah, The Protecting Friend, take charge of my affairs. Take charge of me with Your mercy and guidance until I am filled with security in this life and the Hereafter, for You have said: "Lo! verily the friends of Allah are (those) on whom fear (cometh) not, nor do they grieve"
source: A general supplication ending with a direct quotation of Sūrah Yūnus 10:62.

quran_spans.translation: Lo! verily the friends of Allah are (those) on whom fear (cometh) not, nor do they grieve

name: Du'a using Allah's Name Al-Jabbaar
arabic: يَا جَبَّارُ اجْبُرْ بِخَاطِرِي، اجْبُرْ حَالِي، اجْبُرْ انْكِسَارِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، اجْبُرْ أَلَمِي وَهَمِّي وَحُزْنِي
transliteration: Ya Jabbaaru ijbur bikaatiri, ijbur haali, ijbur inkisaari bayna yadayk, ijbur alami wa hammi wa huzni
translation: O Allah, The Restorer, restore my spirit, restore my condition, restore my brokenness before You, and heal my pain, worry, and sadness.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for concealment and protection
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْنَا فَوْقَ الْأَرْضِ، وَتَحْتَ الْأَرْضِ، وَيَوْمَ الْعَرْضِ
transliteration: Allahummasturna fawqal-ardi, wa tahtal-ardi, wa yawmal-'ard
translation: O Allah, protect and conceal our faults while we are on earth, under the earth, and on the Day of Presentation.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for protection from the evil of others
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
transliteration: Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim, wa na'udhu bika min shururihim
translation: O Allah, we make You our shield against them, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

name: Du'a to stop Shaytan's whispers
arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحۡضُرُونِ
transliteration: Rabbi a'oodhu bika min hamazaatish-shayaateen, wa a'oodhu bika Rabbi an yahduroon
translation: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me

name: Du'a for purification from sins
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
transliteration: Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib, allahummaghsilni min khatayaya bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad
translation: O Allah, separate me from my sins as You have separated the East from the West. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow, and hail.

name: Du'a seeking refuge from bad character
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min munkaratil-akhlaqi wal-a'mali wal-ahwa'
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from reprehensible manners, deeds, and whims.

name: Du'a to seek protection from bad
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبࣲ وَتَبَّ مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارࣰا ذَاتَ لَهَبࣲ‏ وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ فِي جِيدِهَا حَبۡلࣱ مِّن مَّسَدِۭ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Tabbat yadaa Abee Lahabin wa tabb. Maa aghnaa 'anhu maaluhu wa maa kasab. Sayaslaa naaran dhaata lahab. Wamra'atuhu hammaalatal-hatab. Fee jeedihaa hablum mim masad
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish His wealth and gains will not exempt him He will be plunged in flaming Fire And his wife, the wood-carrier Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre

name: Du'a for protection from all harm
arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i, wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim
translation: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name there is protection against every kind of harm in the earth or in the heaven, and He is the All-Hearing and All-Knowing.

name: Du'a for good deeds and love for the needy
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ، وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ، وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ، وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ بِعِبَادِكَ فِتْنَةً فَاقْبِضْنِي إِلَيْكَ غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal-khayrati, wa tarkal-munkarati, wa hubbal-masakini, wa idha aradta bi'ibadika fitnatan faqbidhni ilayka ghayra maftun
translation: O Allah, I beg You to make me do good deeds, shun reprehensible things, and love the needy. If You plan to afflict Your servants with a trial, then take me to You without being afflicted.

name: Du'a seeking refuge from one's own evil
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done.

name: Du'a for sending blessings upon the Prophet (Bukhārī wording)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima, innaka hamidun majid, Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima, innaka hamidun majid
translation: O Allah, send Your mercy upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your mercy upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious

name: Du'a of reliance on Allah
arabic: حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ، نِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakilu, ni'mal-mawla wa ni'man-nasir
translation: Allah is Sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust. A Transcendent Patron, a Transcendent Helper.

quran_spans.translation: Allah is Sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust
A Transcendent Patron, a Transcendent Helper

name: Du'a to remove all sins
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنَّا
transliteration: Allāhumma innaka 'afuwwun tuḥibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'annā
translation: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning; You love pardon, so pardon us.
source: Adapted in the plural for group supplication from Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3513, which reads "fa'fu 'annī" (pardon me).
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3513)

name: Du'a asking for forgiveness and mercy
arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ
transliteration: Rabbighfir li warhamni wa tub 'alayya
translation: My Lord, forgive me, have mercy upon me, and accept my repentance.
source: Adapted from Sunan Abī Dāwūd 1516, which reads "Rabbi-ghfir lī wa tub ʿalayya, innaka anta at-Tawwābu ar-Raḥīm", with "warḥamnī" added.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan Abī Dāwūd 1516)

name: Du'a for forgiveness: My Lord! Lo! in Thee do I seek refuge
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنۡ أَسۡـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيۡسَ لِي بِهِۦ عِلۡمࣱۖ وَإِلَّا تَغۡفِرۡ لِي وَتَرۡحَمۡنِيٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi Inneee A-o’od’u Bika An As-alaka Maa Laysa Lee Bihee I’lm Wa Illaa Taghfirlee Wa Tarh’amneee Akum Minal Khaasireen
translation: My Lord! Lo! in Thee do I seek refuge (from the sin) that I should ask of Thee that whereof I have no knowledge. Unless Thou forgive me and have mercy on me I shall be among the lost

name: Du'a for forgiveness: There is no God save Thee
arabic: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: La illaha illa Anta Subhanak, inni kuntu min adh-dhalimeen
translation: There is no God save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer

name: Du'a for comprehensive forgiveness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
transliteration: Allahummaghfir li, warhamni, wahdini, wajburni, wa 'afini, warzuqni, warfa'ni
translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, support me, protect me, provide for me, and elevate me.
source: Combines Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2697 with "wajburnī" and "warfaʿnī" from the supplication between the two prostrations (Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 284; Sunan Ibn Mājah 898).
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wordings (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2697; Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 284, ṣaḥīḥ according to al-Albānī)

name: Chief du'a for forgiveness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِر لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allaahumma 'Anta Rabbee laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta, khalaqtanee wa 'anaa 'abduk, wa 'anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-tata't, 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa sana't, 'aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa 'aboo'u bithanbee faghfir lee fa'innahu laa yaghfiruth-thunooba 'illaa 'Anta.
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You. You created me and I am your slave. I keep Your covenant, and my pledge to You so far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to Your blessings upon me, and I admit to my misdeeds. Forgive me, for there is none who may forgive sins but You.

name: Du'a for protection from severe trials
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَدَرْكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min jahdil-bala'i, wa darkish-shaqa'i, wa su'il-qada'i, wa shamatatil-a'da'
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the distress of trial, from the lowest level of misery, from the perversity of fate, and from the malicious rejoicing of enemies.

name: Du'a from all distress
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةࣰ وَهَيِّئۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا رَشَدࣰا
transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
translation: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight

name: Du'a for rectification of all affairs
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
transliteration: Allahumma ashlih li diniyal-ladhi huwa 'ismatu amri, wa ashlih li dunyayal-lati fiha ma'ashi, wa ashlih li akhiratiyal-lati fiha ma'adi, waj'alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr
translation: O Allah, rectify for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs, and rectify for me the affairs of this world wherein is my sustenance, and rectify for me my Hereafter to which is my return, and make life for me an increase for every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.

name: Du'a for sending blessings upon the Prophet (Muslim wording)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta 'alā āli Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd, Allāhumma bārik 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammadin kamā bārakta 'alā āli Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
practiceTime: On Fridays, and in the final sitting of every prayer

name: Du'a for health and healing
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, do away with the suffering. Heal, You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no disease behind.

name: Du'a for good health: O Allah grant me health in my body
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa Ant.
translation: O Allah grant me health in my body. O Allah grant me good hearing. O Allah grant me good eyesight. There is no God but You.
grading: Ḥasan according to al-Albānī; ḍaʿīf according to al-Arnaʾūṭ

name: Du'a for good health: And when I sicken, then He healeth me
arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضۡتُ فَهُوَ يَشۡفِينِ
transliteration: Wa idhaa maridtu fa-Huwa yashfeen
translation: And when I sicken, then He healeth me

name: Du'a for good health, conduct and success
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ صِحَّةً فِي إِيمَانٍ، وَإِيمَانًا فِي حُسْنِ خُلُقٍ، وَنَجَاحًا يَتْبَعُهُ فَلَاحٌ، وَرَحْمَةً مِنْكَ وَعَافِيَةً، وَمَغْفِرَةً مِنْكَ وَرِضْوَانًا
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka sihhatan fi iman, wa imanan fi husni khuluq, wa najahan yatba'uhu falah, wa rahmatan minka wa 'afiyah, wa maghfiratan minka wa ridwana
translation: O Allah, I ask You for health with faith, faith with good conduct, success followed by further success, mercy from You, well-being, forgiveness from You, and Your pleasure.

name: Du'a for health and provision
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir li, war-hamni, wah-dini, wa 'afini, war-zuqni
translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.

name: Du'a for relief from pain
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
transliteration: Bismillah, a'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir
translation: With the name of Allah, I seek refuge with Allah and His omnipotence from the evil of what I feel and that which I am wary of.
source: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2202. In the narration, "Bismillah" is said three times and the rest seven times.

name: Du'a for all serious illnesses
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ، وَالْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-barasi, wal-jununi, wal-judhami, wa min sayyi'il-asqam.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leukoderma, insanity, leprosy, and from evil diseases.

name: Du'a for all eye problems
arabic: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدࣱ‏
transliteration: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatim min haadhaa fa-kashafnaa 'anka ghitaa'aka fa-basarukal-yawma hadeed
translation: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day

name: Du'a for well-being in body, hearing and sight
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa Ant
translation: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You.
grading: Ḥasan according to al-Albānī; ḍaʿīf according to al-Arnaʾūṭ

name: Healing verse from the Qur'an: and He will heal the breasts of folk who are believers
arabic: وَيَشۡفِ صُدُورَ قَوۡمࣲ مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa yashfi sudoora qawmim mu'mineen
translation: and He will heal the breasts of folk who are believers

name: Healing verse from the Qur'an: a balm for that which is in the breasts
arabic: وَشِفَآءࣱ لِّمَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ
transliteration: Wa shifaa'ul limaa fis-sudoor
translation: a balm for that which is in the breasts

name: Healing verse from the Qur'an: There cometh forth from their bellies a drink
arabic: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابࣱ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءࣱ لِّلنَّاسِۚ
transliteration: Yakhruju mim butoonihaa sharaabum mukhtalifun alwaanuhu feehi shifaa'ul lin-naas
translation: There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind.

name: Healing verse from the Qur'an: And We reveal of the Qur'an that which is a healing
arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءࣱ وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa nunazzilu minal Qur'aani maa huwa shifaa'un wa rahmatul lil-mu'mineen
translation: And We reveal of the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy for believers

name: Healing verse from the Qur'an: And when I sicken, then He healeth me
arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضۡتُ فَهُوَ يَشۡفِينِ
transliteration: Wa idhaa maridtu fa-Huwa yashfeen
translation: And when I sicken, then He healeth me

name: Healing verse from the Qur'an: Say unto them (O Muhammad): For those who believe it is a guidance
arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هُدࣰى وَشِفَآءࣱۚ
transliteration: Qul huwa lilladheena aamanoo hudan wa shifaa'
translation: Say unto them (O Muhammad): For those who believe it is a guidance and a healing;

name: To relieve toothache or body ache
arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلࣰا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
transliteration: Qul Huwal-ladhee ansha'akum wa ja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idah, qaleelam maa tashkuroon
translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye

name: Du'a for heart pain
arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطۡمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَا بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطۡمَئِنُّ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ
transliteration: Allatheena Aamanu Wa Tatmainna Qolobohom Bi Thiker Allah Illa Bi Thikir Allah Tatmaen Al Qoloob (28) Surat Ar Ra’d
translation: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest

name: Du'a for tummy ache
arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلࣱ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
transliteration: Laa feehaa ghawlun wa laa hum 'anhaa yunzafoon
translation: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby

name: Du'a for severe physical pain
arabic: رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ تَقَدَّسَ اسْمُكَ، أَمْرُكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ، كَمَا رَحْمَتُكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ فَاجْعَلْ رَحْمَتَكَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، اغْفِرْ لَنَا حُوبَنَا وَخَطَايَانَا أَنْتَ رَبُّ الطَّيِّبِينَ، أَنْزِلْ رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَشِفَاءً مِنْ شِفَائِكَ عَلَى هَذَا الْوَجَعِ فَيَبْرَأَ
transliteration: Rabbunallahul-ladhi fis-sama'i taqaddasas-muk, amruka fis-sama'i wal-ard, kama rahmatuka fis-sama'i faj'al rahmataka fil-ard, ighfir lana hubana wa khatayana Anta Rabbut-tayyibin, anzil rahmatan min rahmatika wa shifa'an min shifa'ika 'ala hadhal-waja'i fa yabra'
translation: Our Lord is Allah who is in the heaven. Your name is Holy. Your command is in the heaven and the earth. Just as Your mercy is in the heaven, so place Your mercy on the earth. Forgive us our sins and errors. You are the Lord of the pure ones. Send down a mercy from Your mercy and a healing from Your healing upon this pain so that it is cured.

name: Du'a by an ill person: There is no God save Thee
arabic: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa Anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen
translation: There is no God save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer

name: Du'a by an ill person: There is none worthy of worship but Allah
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: La ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar, la ilaha illallahu wahdah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, la ilaha illallahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, la ilaha illallahu wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone. There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, He has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

name: Du'a when setting out on a journey
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alal-lahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
translation: In the name of Allah, I put my trust in Allah, there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

name: Du'a as you begin your travel: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
transliteration: Bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim. Allahu akbar. Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun
translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Allah is the Greatest. Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them). And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 1342)
source: Adapted from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 1342, which quotes Qur'an 43:13-14 after "Allah is the Greatest" three times. This version adds "In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful" and says "Allah is the Greatest" once.

quran_spans.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them). And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning

name: Du'a as you begin your travel: Allah is the Greatest
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ وَالْوَلَدِ
transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah. Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahl. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safari wa ka'abatil-manzari wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahli wal-walad
translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, facilitate our journey and let us cover its distance quickly. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family. O Allah, I take refuge with You from the difficulties of travel, from having a gloomy sight and a bad predicament, and I take refuge in You from an ill-fated outcome in wealth, family, and children.
source: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 1342 (part), with "and children" as in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3447

name: Du'a when landing
arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلࣰا مُّبَارَكࣰا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakan wa Anta khayrul munzileen
translation: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land
practiceTime: As you Arrive/ Land to Destination

name: Du'a when entering a new town or city
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا جَنَاهَا وَحَبِّبْنَا إِلَى أَهْلِهَا وَحَبِّبْ صَالِحِي أَهْلِهَا إِلَيْنَا
transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fiha, allahummar-zuqna janaha wa habbibna ila ahliha wa habbib salihi ahliha ilayna
translation: O Allah, grant us blessings in this place. O Allah, give us of its produce, make us beloved to its people, and make the righteous of its people beloved to us.

name: Du'a when stopping (layover) along the way
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: A'othu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created

name: Du'a when entering or leaving a place
arabic: رَّبِّ أَدۡخِلۡنِي مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقࣲ وَأَخۡرِجۡنِي مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقࣲ وَٱجۡعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلۡطَٰنࣰا نَّصِيرࣰا
transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqin waj'al lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa
translation: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power

name: Du'a of the traveller when leaving his or her residence
arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
transliteration: Astawdi'ukum-ullaha alladhi la tadi'u wada'i'uh
translation: I leave you in the care of Allah, as nothing is lost that is in His care.

name: Returning from travel
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaha ill-Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna sajiduna li-rabbina hamidun, sadaq-Allahu wa'dahu, wa nasara 'abdahu, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah
translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. We return repentant to our Lord, worshipping our Lord, and praising our Lord. He fulfilled His promise, He aided His slave, and He alone defeated the Confederates.
practiceTime: As you Arrive/ Land to Destination
source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2995, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 1344. The narrations describe saying "Allah is the Greatest" three times on high ground before these words.

name: Du'a for forgiveness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka ya Allahu bi'annakal-wahidul-ahadus-samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad an taghfira li dhunubi innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim
translation: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by the fact that You are the One, the Unique, the Self-Sufficient Master, Who (is described thus): 'He begetteth not nor was begotten. And there is none comparable unto Him,' that You forgive me my sins; indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
practiceTime: After Two Raka'at Anytime: Refer to BEST TIMINGS

quran_spans.translation: He begetteth not nor was begotten. And there is none comparable unto Him

name: For livelihood
arabic: ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ تُؤۡتِي ٱلۡمُلۡكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلۡمُلۡكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلۡخَيۡرُۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏ تُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَتُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَتُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّۖ وَتَرۡزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏ رَحْمَانَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَرَحِيمَهُمَا تُعْطِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُمَا.
transliteration: Allahumma malikal-mulki tu'til-mulka man tasha' wa tanzi'ul-mulka mimman tasha' wa tu'izzu man tasha' wa tudhillu man tasha' biyadikal-khayr innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir tulijul-layla fin-nahar wa tulijun-nahara fil-layli wa tukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyit wa tukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayy wa tarzuqu man tasha'u bighayri hisab rahmanad-dunya wal-akhirati wa rahimahuma tu'ti man tasha'u minhuma
translation: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things. Thou causest the night to pass into the day, and Thou causest the day to pass into the night. And Thou bringest forth the living from the dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead from the living. And Thou givest sustenance to whom Thou choosest, without stint. The Compassionate of this world and the Hereafter, and the Merciful of them both, You grant from them to whom You will.
source: Qur'an 3:26-27, followed by part of a supplication in al-Muʿjam al-Ṣaghīr of al-Ṭabarānī 558, which reads "يَا رَحْمَنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَرَحِيمَهُمَا ، تُعْطِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُمَا ، وَتَمْنَعُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُمَا ، ارْحَمْنِي رَحْمَةً تُغْنِينِي بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ مَنْ سِوَاكَ" (O Most Merciful of this world and the Hereafter and Most Compassionate of both, You give of them to whom You will and withhold them from whom You will; have mercy on me with a mercy that frees me from the mercy of anyone besides You). This version drops the opening "O" and ends before the request.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (al-Albānī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Targhīb 1821)

quran_spans.translation: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things. Thou causest the night to pass into the day, and Thou causest the day to pass into the night. And Thou bringest forth the living from the dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead from the living. And Thou givest sustenance to whom Thou choosest, without stint

name: Istikhara du'a
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'adhim, fa'innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fih.
