Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anhu waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bih.
translation: O Allah, verily I seek the better [of either choice] from You, by Your knowledge, and I seek ability from You, by Your power, and I ask You from Your immense bounty. For indeed You have power, and I am powerless; You have knowledge and I know not; You are the Knower of the unseen realms. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me with regard to my religion, my livelihood and the end of my affair then decree it for me, facilitate it for me, and grant me blessing in it. And if You know that this matter is not good for me with regard to my religion, my livelihood and the end of my affair then turn it away from me and me from it; and decree for me better than it, wherever it may be, and make me content with it.
source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 1162, without the narrator's alternative wording ("or he said: in my present and later affairs")

name: Du'a as Ramadan approaches
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ سَلِّمْنِي لِرَمَضَانَ، وَسَلِّمْ رَمَضَانَ لِي، وَتَسَلَّمْهُ مِنِّي مُتَقَبَّلًا
transliteration: Allāhumma sallimnī li-Ramaḍāna, wa sallim Ramaḍāna lī, wa tasallamhu minnī mutaqabbalā
translation: O Allah, keep me safe until Ramadan, keep Ramadan safe for me, and receive it from me as accepted.
source: Reported as a supplication of the early Muslims, from the Successor Makḥūl (al-Ṭabarānī, al-Duʿāʾ 913). The version attributed to the Prophet (peace be upon him) is weak (al-Duʿāʾ 912).
grading: Not a prophetic hadith; the attributed version is Ḍaʿīf

name: Sighting the new moon
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالأَمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ، وَبِالسَّلَامَةِ وَالإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, Allāhumma ahillahu ʿalaynā bi-l-amni wa-l-īmāni, wa bi-s-salāmati wa-l-Islāmi, wa-t-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu Rabbanā wa tarḍā, Rabbunā wa Rabbuka-llāhu
translation: Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, bring this new moon upon us with security and faith, with safety and Islam, and with guidance to what You love, our Lord, and are pleased with. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
practiceTime: On sighting the new crescent moon of any month, including Ramadan
source: Sunan al-Dārimī, from Ibn ʿUmar. Said on sighting the crescent of any lunar month, including Ramadan.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ through supporting narrations (Al-Albānī, al-Kalim al-Ṭayyib)

name: Upon breaking the fast
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
transliteration: Allāhumma laka ṣumtu wa ʿalā rizqika afṭartu
translation: O Allah, for You I have fasted, and with Your provision I have broken my fast.
source: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 2358: Ḍaʿīf (weak chain). The sound wording, Sunan Abī Dāwūd 2357, is in the Fasting collection.

name: Breaking the fast at someone's house
arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
transliteration: Afṭara ʿindakumu aṣ-ṣāʾimūna, wa akala ṭaʿāmakumu al-abrāru, wa ṣallat ʿalaykumu al-malāʾikatu.
translation: May the fasting break their fast with you, the righteous eat your food, and the angels pray for you.
practiceTime: For your host, when you break your fast at their home
source: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1747: Ṣaḥīḥ. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said this when he broke his fast at the home of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh. Also reported in Sunan Abī Dāwūd 3854 (Ṣaḥīḥ, Al-Albānī).

name: When insulted while fasting
arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
transliteration: Innī ṣāʾimun, innī ṣāʾim
translation: Indeed, I am fasting; indeed, I am fasting.
practiceTime: When someone insults or provokes you while you are fasting
source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 1894; Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 1151. A statement said in response to provocation, rather than a supplication.

name: Supplication for Islam and the Muslims
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِزَّ الإِسْلَامَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Allāhumma aʿizza-l-Islāma wa-l-Muslimīna
translation: O Allah, honour and strengthen Islam and the Muslims.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣰ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةࣰ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid dunyaa hasana wa fil aakhirati hasana wa qina athab alnar
translation: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمٌ
transliteration: Rabbanaa Innaka Ra‘oofon Raheem
translation: Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Accept from us (this duty)
arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbanaa taqabbal minna innaka antas Samee‘ul Aleem
translation: Our Lord! Accept from us (this duty). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Decide with truth between us and our folk
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰتِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaf-tah  baynana wa baina qawmina bil haqq wa anta khairul fatiheen
translation: Our Lord! Decide with truth between us and our folk, for Thou art the best of those who make decision
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih, wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa, Anta Mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡنَا صَبۡرࣰا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسۡلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa afrigh ’alaina sabran wa tawaffana muslimeen
translation: Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness and make us die as men who have surrendered (unto Thee)
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbanna ughfir lee wa liwaalidaiya wa lilmu‘mineena yawma yaqoomul hisaab
translation: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرࣰا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ
transliteration: Rabbana wa laa tahmil alainaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo alal latheena min qablinaa
translation: Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us!
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Lord of us! Send down for us a table spread with food from heaven
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلۡ عَلَيۡنَا مَآئِدَةࣰ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدࣰا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةࣰ مِّنكَۖ وَٱرۡزُقۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa anzil 'alaynaa maa'idatam minas-samaa'i takoonu lanaa 'eedal li-awwalinaa wa aakhirinaa wa aayatam minka warzuqnaa wa Anta khayrur-raaziqeen
translation: Lord of us! Send down for us a table spread with food from heaven, that it may be a feast for us, for the first of us and for the last of us, and a sign from Thee. Give us sustenance, for Thou art the Best of Sustainers
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring
arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنࣲ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbana hab lanaa min azwaajina wa thurriyatina qurata ayunin waj alaana lilmuttaqeena imamaa
translation: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil)
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوبَنَا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَيۡتَنَا وَهَبۡ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana baaeda ith hadaitana wa hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah innaka antal wahhaab
translation: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَلِإِخۡوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلࣰّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ
transliteration: Rabbanaa ighfir lanaa wa li-ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillal lilladheena aamanoo
translation: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe.
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Therefor forgive us our sins
arabic: رَبَّنَا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرۡ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ
transliteration: Rabbana faghfir lanaa thunoobana wa kaffir Anna saiyiaatina wa tawaffanaa maal abraar
translation: Our Lord! Therefor forgive us our sins, and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die the death of the righteous
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةࣰ وَهَيِّئۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا رَشَدࣰا
transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
translation: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! forgive us for our sins and wasted efforts
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسۡرَافَنَا فِيٓ أَمۡرِنَا وَثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanna aghfir lana thunoobanaa wa israafanaa fee amrinaa wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurna alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! forgive us for our sins and wasted efforts, make our foothold sure, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship
arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabb ijalnee muqeema assalaati wa min thurriyaatee Rabbana wa taqabbal duaa
translation: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Thou createdst not this in vain
arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقۡتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلࣰا سُبۡحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana maa khalaqta hatha baatilan subhaanaka faqina athaab annaar
translation: Our Lord! Thou createdst not this in vain. Glory be to Thee! Preserve us from the doom of Fire
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ
transliteration: Rabbanaa innana nakhaafu ai yafruta alainaa aw ai yatghaa
translation: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! And give us that which Thou hast promised to us by Thy messengers
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخۡزِنَا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۖ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'attanaa 'alaa rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa yawmal qiyaamah, innaka laa tukhliful mee'aad
translation: Our Lord! And give us that which Thou hast promised to us by Thy messengers. Confound us not upon the Day of Resurrection. Lo! Thou breakest not the tryst
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord, we believe
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanna aamanna faktubnaa maash shaahideen
translation: Our Lord, we believe. Inscribe us as among the witnesses
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Lo! it is Thou Who gatherest mankind together
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوۡمࣲ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbana innaka jaami unnaasi li yawmil laa raiba feeh inna allah laa yukhliful meeaad
translation: Our Lord! Lo! it is Thou Who gatherest mankind together to a Day of which there is no doubt. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورࣱ شَكُورٌ
transliteration: Rabbana La ghafurun shakoor
translation: Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! And make them enter the Gardens of Eden
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهُۥۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbanaa wa adkhilhum jannaati 'adninil-latee wa'attahum wa man salaha min aabaa'ihim wa azwaajihim wa dhurriyyaatihim, innaka Antal 'Azeezul Hakeem. Wa qihimus-sayyi'aat, wa man taqis-sayyi'aati yawma'idhin faqad rahimtah, wa dhaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem
translation: Our Lord! And make them enter the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised them, with such of their fathers and their wives and their descendants as do right. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise And ward off from them ill-deeds; and he from whom Thou wardest off ill-deeds that day, him verily hast Thou taken into mercy. That is the supreme triumph
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbannaa inanaa amanna faghfir lana thunoobana wa qinaa athaab alnaar
translation: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins and guard us from the punishment of Fire
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta khayrur-raahimeen
translation: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Whom Thou causest to enter the Fire: him indeed Thou hast confounded
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدۡخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدۡ أَخۡزَيۡتَهُۥۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارࣲ‏
transliteration: Rabbanna innaka man tudkhil il naara faqad akhzaitah wa maa lilthaalimeena min ansaar
translation: Our Lord! Whom Thou causest to enter the Fire: him indeed Thou hast confounded. For evil-doers there will be no helpers
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Lo! we have heard a crier calling unto Faith
arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعۡنَا مُنَادِيࣰا يُنَادِي لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ أَنۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَـَٔامَنَّاۚ
transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa samiinaa munaadiyai yunaadee lil eemaani an aamino bi rabbikum fa aamannaa
translation: Our Lord! Lo! we have heard a crier calling unto Faith: "Believe ye in your Lord!" So we believed.
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرࣰّا وَمُقَامࣰا
transliteration: Rabbana asrif annaa athaaba jahannam inn athaabahaa kaana  gharaamaa Innahaa saaat mustaqarra wa muqaamaa
translation: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish Lo! it is wretched as abode and station
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! We believe in that which Thou hast revealed
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ وَٱتَّبَعۡنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana aamanaa bima anzalta wattabaana arrasool faktubnaa maash shaahideen
translation: Our Lord! We believe in that which Thou hast revealed and we follow him whom Thou hast sent. Enrol us among those who witness (to the truth)
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءࣲ رَّحۡمَةࣰ وَعِلۡمࣰا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Rabbanna wasiata kulla shayin  rahmatanw wa ilman faghfir lillatheena taaboo wattabaoo sabeelaka wa  qihim athaabal jaheem
translation: Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefor forgive those who repent and follow Thy way. Ward off from them the punishment of hell
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Oh, make us not a lure for the wrongdoing folk
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحۡمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen, wa najjinaa bi-rahmatika minal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! Oh, make us not a lure for the wrongdoing folk And, of Thy mercy, save us from the folk that disbelieve
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves
arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمۡنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمۡ تَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَتَرۡحَمۡنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanna thalamnaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lala wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal  khaasireen
translation: Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If thou forgive us not and have not mercy on us, surely we are of the lost
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡنَا صَبۡرࣰا وَثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana affrigh alainaa sabran wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ
transliteration: Rabbana laa tu aakhithnaaa in naseenaa aw akhtaanaa
translation: Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark!
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! And make us submissive unto Thee
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا مُسۡلِمَيۡنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةࣰ مُّسۡلِمَةࣰ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبۡ عَلَيۡنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana wajalnaa muslimaini laka wa min thurriyyatinaa ummatam muslimatal lak wa arinaa manaasikanaa wa tub alainaa innaka antat tawaabur raheem
translation: Our Lord! And make us submissive unto Thee and of our seed a nation submissive unto Thee, and show us our ways of worship, and relent toward us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Relenting, the Merciful
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Place us not with the wrong-doing folk
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbannaa la tajalnaa maal qawmith thaalimeen
translation: Our Lord! Place us not with the wrong-doing folk
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعۡلَمُ مَا نُخۡفِي وَمَا نُعۡلِنُۗ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءࣲ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbanaa innaka taalamu maa nukhfee wa maa nulin wa maa yakhfaa alal laahi min shaiin fil ardi wa laa fis samaa
translation: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏
transliteration: Rabbanaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lana innaka alaa kulli shayin qadeer
translation: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا رَبَّنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana la tajalnaa fitnatal lilatheena kafaroo waghfir lanaa rabbanaa innaka antal azeezul hakeem
translation: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust
arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Rabbanaa 'alayka tawakkalnaa wa ilayka anabnaa wa ilaykal maseer
translation: Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying
practiceTime: During Month of Ramadan or in Need of Spiritual Healing

name: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr: apportionment and a blessed ending
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فَاقْسِمْ لِي فِيهَا خَيْرَ مَا قَسَمْتَ، وَاخْتِمْ لِي فِي قَضَائِكَ خَيْرَ مِمَّا خَتَمْتَ، وَاخْتِمْ لِي بِالسَّعَادَةِ فِيمَنْ خَتَمْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ اسْمِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ، وَرُوحِي مَعَ الشُّهَدَاءِ، وَإِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ، وَإِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً
transliteration: Allāhumma in kānat hādhihi laylata al-qadri faqsim lī fīhā khayra mā qasamta, wakhtim lī fī qaḍā'ika khayra mimmā khatamta, wakhtim lī bis-sa'ādati fīman khatamta, Allāhumma ij'al ismī wa dhurriyyatī fī hādhihi al-laylati fis-su'adā'i, wa rūḥī ma'ash-shuhadā'i, wa iḥsānī fī 'illiyyīna, wa isā'atī maghfūrah
translation: O Allah, if this night is Laylat al-Qadr, apportion for me in it the best of what You have apportioned, seal for me in Your decree better than what You have sealed, and seal my life with happiness among those You have sealed. O Allah, place my name and my offspring on this night among the blessed, my soul with the martyrs, my good deeds in 'Illiyyin (the highest register), and make my wrongdoings forgiven.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Part of a night-prayer supplication on Laylat al-Qadr.

name: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr: doors of good and protection from trial
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيَ اللَّيْلَةَ بَابَ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ فَتَحْتَهُ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ وَلَا تَسُدَّهُ عَنِّي، وَارْزُقْنِي رِزْقًا تُغِيثُنِي بِهِ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الطَّيِّبِ الْحَلَالِ، اللَّهُمَّ مَا قَسَمْتَ فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ الْمُبَارَكَةِ مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَصِحَّةٍ وَسَلَامَةٍ وَسَعَةِ رِزْقٍ فَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْهُ نَصِيبًا، وَمَا أَنْزَلْتَ فِيهَا مِنْ سُوءٍ وَبَلَاءٍ وَشَرٍّ وَفِتْنَةٍ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَعَنْ جَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Allāhumma iftaḥ liya al-laylata bāba kulli khayrin fataḥtahu li-aḥadin min khalqika wa awliyā'ika wa ahli ṭā'atika wa lā tasuddahu 'annī, warzuqnī rizqan tughīthunī bihi min rizqika aṭ-ṭayyibi al-ḥalāli, Allāhumma mā qasamta fī hādhihi al-laylati al-mubārakati min khayrin wa 'āfiyatin wa ṣiḥḥatin wa salāmatin wa sa'ati rizqin faj'al lī minhu naṣīban, wa mā anzalta fīhā min sū'in wa balā'in wa sharrin wa fitnatin faṣrifhu 'annī wa 'an jamī'i al-muslimīn
translation: O Allah, open for me tonight the door of every good that You have opened for any of Your creation, Your close friends, and the people of Your obedience, and do not close it to me. Grant me provision by which You aid me from Your good and lawful provision. O Allah, whatever You have apportioned on this blessed night of good, well-being, health, safety, and abundant provision, grant me a share of it; and whatever You have sent down in it of harm, trial, evil, and tribulation, avert it from me and from all Muslims.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Part of a night-prayer supplication on Laylat al-Qadr.

name: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr: acceptance of deeds and forgiveness of shortcomings
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا كَانَ فِيهَا مِنْ ذِكْرٍ وَشُكْرٍ فَتَقَبَّلْهُ مِنِّي وَأَحْسِنْ قَبُولَهُ، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ تَفْرِيطٍ وَتَقْصِيرٍ وَتَضْيِيعٍ فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنِّي بِسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ تَغَمَّدْنِي فِيهَا بِسَابِغِ كَرَمِكَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي فِيهَا مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي خَيْرًا مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ مَعَ عَظِيمِ الْأَجْرِ وَكَرِيمِ الذُّخْرِ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَصْرِفْنِي مِنْ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ إِلَّا بِذَنْبٍ مَغْفُورٍ، وَسَعْيٍ مَشْكُورٍ، وَعَمَلٍ مُتَقَبَّلٍ مَبْرُورٍ، وَتِجَارَةٍ لَنْ تَبُورَ، وَشِفَاءٍ لِمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ، وَتَوْبَةٍ خَالِصَةٍ لِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: Allāhumma mā kāna fīhā min dhikrin wa shukrin fataqabbalhu minnī wa aḥsin qabūlahu, wa mā kāna min tafrīṭin wa taqṣīrin wa taḍyī'in fatajāwaz 'annī bisa'ati raḥmatika yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīna, Allāhumma taghammadnī fīhā bisābighi karamika, waj'alnī fīhā min awliyā'ika, waj'alhā lī khayran min alfi shahrin ma'a 'aẓīmi al-ajri wa karīmi adh-dhukhri, Allāhumma lā taṣrifnī min hādhihi al-laylati illā bidhanbin maghfūrin, wa sa'yin mashkūrin, wa 'amalin mutaqabbalin mabrūrin, wa tijāratin lan tabūra, wa shifā'in limā fiṣ-ṣudūri, wa tawbatin khāliṣatin liwajhika al-karīm
translation: O Allah, whatever remembrance and gratitude there was in it, accept it from me and perfect its acceptance; and whatever negligence, shortcoming, and wasting of time there was, overlook it from me by the vastness of Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. O Allah, envelop me in it with Your abundant generosity, make me in it among Your close friends, and make it for me better than a thousand months with immense reward and noble treasure. O Allah, do not let me leave this night except with a forgiven sin, an appreciated effort, an accepted and blessed deed, a trade that will never perish, a healing for what is in the hearts, and a sincere repentance for Your noble countenance.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Part of a night-prayer supplication on Laylat al-Qadr.

name: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr: deliverance from the Fire and answered prayer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي وَأَهْلِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ جَمِيعًا فِيهَا مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ وَطُلَقَائِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ مِمَّنْ نَظَرْتَ إِلَيْهِ فَرَحِمْتَهُ وَسَمِعْتَ دُعَاءَهُ فَأَجَبْتَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَأَسْرَارِهَا وَأَنْوَارِهَا وَبَرَكَاتِهَا أَنْ تَتَقَبَّلَ مَا دَعَوْتُكَ بِهِ وَأَنْ تَقْضِيَ حَاجَتِي يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Allāhumma ij'alnī wa ahlī wa dhurriyyatī wal-muslimīna jamī'an fīhā min 'utaqā'ika min jahannama wa ṭulaqā'ika min an-nāri, Allāhumma ij'alnī fī hādhihi al-laylati mimman naẓarta ilayhi faraḥimtahu wa sami'ta du'ā'ahu fa-ajabtahu, Allāhumma as'aluka fī laylati al-qadri wa asrārihā wa anwārihā wa barakātihā an tataqabbala mā da'awtuka bihi wa an taqḍiya ḥājatī yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīn
translation: O Allah, make me, my family, my offspring, and all the Muslims on this night among those You have freed from Hell and released from the Fire. O Allah, make me on this night among those upon whom You looked and had mercy, and whose supplication You heard and answered. O Allah, I ask You on Laylat al-Qadr, and by its secrets, its lights, and its blessings, to accept what I have supplicated to You for and to fulfil my need, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Part of a night-prayer supplication on Laylat al-Qadr.

name: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr: forgiveness, healing, and fulfilment of every need
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لَنَا يَا رَبَّنَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ الْعَظِيمَةِ ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ، وَلَا مَرِيضًا إِلَّا شَفَيْتَهُ، وَلَا مَيِّتًا إِلَّا رَحِمْتَهُ، وَلَا دُعَاءً إِلَّا اسْتَجَبْتَهُ، وَلَا تَائِبًا إِلَّا قَبِلْتَهُ، وَلَا عَارِيًا إِلَّا كَسَوْتَهُ، وَلَا فَقِيرًا إِلَّا أَغْنَيْتَهُ، وَلَا مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا ثَبَّتَّهُ، وَلَا مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا ثَبَّتَّهُ، وَلَا مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا ثَبَّتَّهُ، وَلَا طَالِبًا إِلَّا وَفَّقْتَهُ، وَلَا عَاصِيًا إِلَّا هَدَيْتَهُ، وَلَا مَظْلُومًا إِلَّا نَصَرْتَهُ، وَلَا عَدُوًّا إِلَّا أَخَذْتَهُ، وَلَا عَدُوًّا إِلَّا أَهْلَكْتَهُ، وَلَا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ هِيَ لَكَ فِيهَا رِضًا وَلَنَا فِيهَا صَلَاحٌ إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا وَيَسَّرْتَهَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Allāhumma lā tada' lanā yā rabbanā fī hādhihi al-laylati al-'aẓīmati dhanban illā ghafartahu, wa lā marīḍan illā shafaytahu, wa lā mayyitan illā raḥimtahu, wa lā du'ā'an illā istajabtahu, wa lā tā'iban illā qabiltahu, wa lā 'āriyan illā kasawtahu, wa lā faqīran illā aghnaytahu, wa lā mu'minan illā thabbattahu, wa lā mu'minan illā thabbattahu, wa lā mu'minan illā thabbattahu, wa lā ṭāliban illā waffaqtahu, wa lā 'āṣiyan illā hadaytahu, wa lā maẓlūman illā naṣartahu, wa lā 'aduwwan illā akhadhtahu, wa lā 'aduwwan illā ahlaktahu, wa lā ḥājatan min ḥawā'iji ad-dunyā wal-ākhirati hiya laka fīhā riḍan wa lanā fīhā ṣalāḥun illā qaḍaytahā wa yassartahā biraḥmatika yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīna, yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīna, yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīna, yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīn
translation: O Allah, our Lord, do not leave for us on this great night any sin except that You forgive it, nor any sick person except that You heal them, nor any deceased person except that You have mercy on them, nor any supplication except that You answer it, nor any repentant person except that You accept them, nor any unclothed person except that You clothe them, nor any poor person except that You enrich them, nor any believer except that You make them steadfast, nor any believer except that You make them steadfast, nor any believer except that You make them steadfast, nor any student except that You grant them success, nor any sinner except that You guide them, nor any wronged person except that You aid them, nor any enemy except that You seize them, nor any enemy except that You destroy them, nor any need among the needs of this world and the Hereafter in which there is pleasure for You and goodness for us except that You fulfil it and make it easy, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful, O Most Merciful of the merciful, O Most Merciful of the merciful, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Part of a night-prayer supplication on Laylat al-Qadr.

name: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr: plea of the distressed and humble
arabic: يَا قَاضِيَ الْحَاجَاتِ، يَا قَاضِيَ الْحَاجَاتِ، يَا قَاضِيَ الْحَاجَاتِ، يَا مُجِيبَ الدَّعَوَاتِ، اللَّهُمَّ يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ، يَا كَاشِفَ الْغَمِّ، يَا مُجِيبَ دَعْوَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ، لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا، نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبَّنَا مَسْأَلَةَ الْمَسَاكِينِ، وَنَبْتَهِلُ إِلَيْكَ يَا رَبَّنَا ابْتِهَالَ الْخَاضِعِ الْمُذْنِبِ الذَّلِيلِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَدْعُوكَ دُعَاءَ مَنْ خَضَعَتْ لَكَ رَقَبَتُهُ، وَذَلَّ لَكَ جِسْمُهُ، وَرَغِمَ لَكَ أَنْفُهُ، وَفَاضَتْ لَكَ عَيْنَاهُ، يَا مَنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ، يَا مَنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ، يَا مَنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ، وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ عَمَّنْ نَادَاهُ
transliteration: Yā qāḍiya al-ḥājāti, yā qāḍiya al-ḥājāti, yā qāḍiya al-ḥājāti, yā mujība ad-da'awāti, Allāhumma yā fārija al-hammi, yā kāshifa al-ghammi, yā mujība da'wati al-muḍṭarrīna, lā yakhfā 'alayka shay'un min amrinā, nas'aluka yā rabbanā mas'alata al-masākīni, wa nabtahilu ilayka yā rabbanā ibtihāla al-khāḍi'i al-mudhnibi adh-dhalīli, Allāhumma nad'ūka du'ā'a man khaḍa'at laka raqabatuhu, wa dhalla laka jismuhu, wa raghima laka anfuhu, wa fāḍat laka 'aynāhu, yā man yujību al-muḍṭarra idhā da'āhu, yā man yujību al-muḍṭarra idhā da'āhu, yā man yujību al-muḍṭarra idhā da'āhu, wa yakshifu as-sū'a 'amman nādāhu
translation: O Fulfiller of needs, O Fulfiller of needs, O Fulfiller of needs, O Answerer of supplications. O Allah, O Reliever of distress, O Remover of grief, O Answerer of the supplication of the distressed, nothing of our affair is hidden from You. We ask You, O our Lord, with the asking of the needy, and we implore You, O our Lord, with the humble plea of a submissive, sinful, lowly servant. O Allah, we call upon You with the supplication of one whose neck has bowed to You, whose body has humbled itself to You, whose nose has submitted in the dust for You, and whose eyes have overflowed with tears for You. O He who answers the distressed when they call upon Him, O He who answers the distressed when they call upon Him, O He who answers the distressed when they call upon Him, and removes harm from those who call upon Him.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Part of a night-prayer supplication on Laylat al-Qadr.

name: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr: a good ending and the Prophet's intercession
arabic: يَا رَبَّنَا اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ أَعْمَارِنَا آخِرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ أَعْمَالِنَا خَوَاتِيمَهَا، وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِنَا يَوْمَ أَنْ نَلْقَاكَ، وَأَغْنِنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا شَفَاعَةَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ أَفْضَلُ الصَّلَاةِ وَالسَّلَامِ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ، وَاسْقِنَا مِنْ يَدِهِ الشَّرِيفَةِ شَرْبَةً هَنِيئَةً لَا نَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا
transliteration: Yā rabbanā ij'al khayra a'mārinā ākhirahā, wa khayra a'mālinā khawātīmahā, wa khayra ayyāminā yawma an nalqāka, wa aghninā bifaḍlika 'amman siwāka, Allāhumma urzuqnā shafā'ata sayyidinā Muḥammadin 'alayhi afḍalu aṣ-ṣalāti was-salāmi, wa awridnā ḥawḍahu, wasqinā min yadihi ash-sharīfati sharbatan hanī'atan lā naẓma'u ba'dahā abadā
translation: O our Lord, make the best of our lives their end, the best of our deeds their conclusions, and the best of our days the day we meet You, and enrich us by Your grace so that we have no need of anyone besides You. O Allah, grant us the intercession of our master Muhammad (upon him be the best of prayers and peace), bring us to his Pond (al-Hawd), and grant us from his noble hand a wholesome drink after which we will never thirst again.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Part of a night-prayer supplication on Laylat al-Qadr.

name: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr: companionship of the Prophet and standing in prayer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا آمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَمْ نَرَهُ فَلَا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ حَتَّى تُدْخِلَنَا مُدْخَلَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْزِهِ عَنَّا خَيْرَ مَا جَزَيْتَ بِهِ نَبِيًّا عَنْ قَوْمِهِ، وَرَسُولًا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا بَلَّغْتَنَا رَمَضَانَ، نَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنَا مِمَّنْ وُفِّقَ لِقِيَامِ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ، وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَنَا مِمَّنْ وُفِّقَ لِقِيَامِ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ، وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَنَا مِمَّنْ وُفِّقَ لِقِيَامِ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا خَيْرَهَا، وَعَفْوَهَا، وَكَرَمَهَا وَفَضْلَهَا، يَا اللَّهُ، يَا اللَّهُ، يَا اللَّهُ، رَبِّ إِنِّي طَرَقْتُ بَابَكَ فَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْ عَظِيمِ بَلَائِكَ
transliteration: Allāhumma kamā āmannā bihi wa lam narahu falā tufarriq baynanā wa baynahu ḥattā tudkhilanā mudkhalahu, Allāhumma ijzihi 'annā khayra mā jazayta bihi nabiyyan 'an qawmihi, wa rasūlan 'an ummatihi, biraḥmatika yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīna, Allāhumma kamā ballaghtanā Ramaḍāna, nas'aluka yā Allāhu an taj'alanā mimman wuffiqa liqiyāmi laylati al-qadri, wa an taj'alanā mimman wuffiqa liqiyāmi laylati al-qadri, wa an taj'alanā mimman wuffiqa liqiyāmi laylati al-qadri, Allāhumma urzuqnā khayrahā, wa 'afwahā, wa karamahā wa faḍlahā, yā Allāhu, yā Allāhu, yā Allāhu, rabbi innī ṭaraqtu bābaka faftaḥ lī abwāba samāwātika, wa ajirnī min 'aẓīmi balā'ik
translation: O Allah, just as we have believed in him (Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)) without seeing him, do not separate us from him until You admit us to where he is admitted. O Allah, reward him on our behalf with the best of what You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his people, and any messenger on behalf of his nation, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. O Allah, just as You have enabled us to reach Ramadan, we ask You, O Allah, to make us among those granted success to stand in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr, to make us among those granted success to stand in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr, and to make us among those granted success to stand in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr. O Allah, grant us its good, its pardon, its generosity, and its bounty, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah. My Lord, I have knocked at Your door, so open for me the gates of Your heavens, and protect me from the magnitude of Your trial.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him). Part of a night-prayer supplication on Laylat al-Qadr.

name: The Prophet's du'a for Laylat al-Qadr
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
transliteration: Allāhumma innaka 'afuwwun tuḥibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'annī
translation: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning; You love pardon, so pardon me.
practiceTime: On the nights you seek Laylat al-Qadr, in the last ten nights of Ramadan
source: Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3513; Sunan Ibn Mājah 3850. ʿĀʾishah asked the Prophet (peace be upon him) what to say on Laylat al-Qadr, and he taught her this.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ (al-Tirmidhī: ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ; al-Ḥākim, al-Nawawī, al-Albānī, al-Arnaʾūṭ)

name: Du'a on completing the Qur'an: O Allah, have mercy on me through the Quran
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي بِالْقُرْآنِ وَاجْعَلْهُ لِي إِمَامًا وَنُورًا وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً اللَّهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنِي مِنْهُ مَا نَسِيتُ وَعَلِّمْنِي مِنْهُ مَا جَهِلْتُ وَارْزُقْنِي تِلَاوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ وَاجْعَلْهُ لِي حُجَّةً يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
transliteration: Allahummar-hamni bil-qur'an, waj'alhu li imaman wa nuran wa hudan wa rahmah, Allahumma dhakkirni minhu ma nasitu, wa 'allimni minhu ma jahiltu, warzuqni tilawatahu ana'al-layli wa atrafan-nahar, waj'alhu li hujjatan ya rabbal-'alamin
translation: O Allah, have mercy on me through the Quran and make it for me a guide, a light, a guidance, and a mercy. O Allah, remind me of what I have forgotten from it, teach me what I am ignorant of from it, and grant me its recitation during the hours of the night and the edges of the day, and make it a proof for me, O Lord of the worlds.
practiceTime: Recite once you have completed reading the whole Holy Quran
source: A traditional supplication recorded by al-Ghazālī in Iḥyāʾ ʿUlūm al-Dīn; not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a on completing the Qur'an: O Allah, rectify for me my religion
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
transliteration: Allahumma ashlih li diniyal-ladhi huwa 'ismatu amri, wa ashlih li dunyayal-lati fiha ma'ashi, wa ashlih li akhiratiyal-lati fiha ma'adi, waj'alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr
translation: O Allah, rectify for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs, and rectify for me the affairs of this world wherein is my sustenance, and rectify for me my Hereafter to which is my return, and make life for me an increase for every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.
practiceTime: Recite once you have completed reading the whole Holy Quran

name: Du'a on completing the Qur'an: O Allah, I ask You for the best of requests
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ وَخَيْرَ الْعِلْمِ وَخَيْرَ الْعَمَلِ وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ وَخَيْرَ الْحَيَاةِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَمَاتِ وَثَبِّتْنِي وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتِي وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلَاتِي وَاغْفِرْ خَطِيئَاتِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral-mas'alati wa khayrad-du'a'i wa khayran-najahi wa khayral-'ilmi wa khayral-'amali wa khayrath-thawabi wa khayral-hayati wa khayral-mamat, wa thabbitni wa thaqqil mawazini wa haqqiq imani warfa' darajati wa taqabbal salati waghfir khati'ati, wa as'alukal-'ula minal-jannah
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best of requests, the best of supplications, the best of success, the best of knowledge, the best of deeds, the best of rewards, the best of life, and the best of death. And make me firm, make my scales heavy, actualise my faith, raise my ranks, accept my prayers, and forgive my sins, and I ask You for the highest levels of Paradise.
practiceTime: Recite once you have completed reading the whole Holy Quran
source: Adapted from al-Mustadrak of al-Ḥākim 1911, which reads "اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ، وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ، وَخَيْرَ الْعَمَلِ، وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ، وَخَيْرَ الْحَيَاةِ، وَخَيْرَ الْمَمَاتِ، وَثَبِّتْنِي، وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي، وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَاتِي، وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلاَتِي، وَاغْفِرْ خَطِيئَتِي، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ" (the same supplication without "the best of knowledge"). This version adds "the best of knowledge" and differs slightly at the end.
grading: Ḍaʿīf in its original wording (al-Albānī, Ḍaʿīf al-Jāmiʿ 1174)

name: Du'a on completing the Qur'an: O Allah, I ask You for that which brings Your mercy
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ، وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ، وَالْفَوْزَ بِالْجَنَّةِ، وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka mujibati rahmatika, wa 'aza'ima maghfiratika, was-salamata min kulli ithm, wal-ghanimata min kulli birr, wal-fawza bil-jannah, wan-najata minan-nar
translation: O Allah, I ask You for that which brings Your mercy and the means of Your forgiveness, safety from every sin, the benefit of every good deed, success in attaining Paradise, and deliverance from the Fire.
practiceTime: Recite once you have completed reading the whole Holy Quran

name: Du'a on completing the Qur'an: O Allah, do not leave for us any sin
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لَنَا ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ، وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ، وَلَا دَيْنًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهُ، وَلَا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma la tada' lana dhanban illa ghafartah, wa la hamman illa farrajtah, wa la daynan illa qadaytah, wa la hajatan min hawa'ijid-dunya wal-akhirati illa qadaytaha ya arhamar-rahimin
translation: O Allah, do not leave for us any sin but that You forgive it, nor any distress but that You relieve it, nor any debt but that You pay it, nor any need of this world and the Hereafter but that You fulfil it, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy.
practiceTime: Recite once you have completed reading the whole Holy Quran
source: Adapted from Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 479, which reads "لَا تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ وَلَا هَمَّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ وَلَا حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ" (Do not leave me a sin but that You forgive it, nor a worry but that You relieve it, nor a need that pleases You but that You fulfil it, O Most Merciful of the merciful). This version says "us" instead of "me", adds "nor any debt but that You settle it", and widens the last request.

name: Du'a on completing the Qur'an: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣰ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةࣰ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الْأَخْيَارِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar, wa sallallahu 'ala sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammad, wa 'ala alihi wa ashabihil-akhyar, wa sallama tasliman kathira
translation: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire. And may Allah send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, and upon his family and his righteous companions, and grant them abundant peace.
practiceTime: Recite once you have completed reading the whole Holy Quran
source: Qur'an 2:201, followed by a salawat (a blessing on the Prophet, peace be upon him) that is not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).
grading: Qur'anic verse; the salawat is not a narration

quran_spans.translation: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire

name: Du'a for a father's long life
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَمْدِدْ فِي عُمْرِ أَبِي بِالصِّحَّةِ وَالْعَافِيَةِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ وَرِضَاكَ
transliteration: Allahumma amdid fi 'umri abi bis-sihhati wal-'afiyati fi ta'atika wa ridak
translation: O Allah, extend my father's life with health and well-being in Your obedience and pleasure.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a father's health and well-being
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْ أَبِي الصِّحَّةَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ
transliteration: Allahummar-zuq abis-sihhata wal-'afiyah
translation: O Allah, grant my father health and well-being.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a father's devotion
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنَ الذَّاكِرِينَ لَكَ وَالشَّاكِرِينَ لَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma-j'alhu min adh-dhakirina laka wash-shakirina lak
translation: O Allah, make him among those who remember You and are thankful to You.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a father's relief
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُ ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ، وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُ حَاجَةً عِنْدَ أَحَدٍ غَيْرِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma la taj'al lahu dhanban illa ghafartah, wa la hamman illa farrajtah, Allahumma wa la taj'al lahu hajatan 'inda ahadin ghayrak
translation: O Allah, do not leave for him any sin except that You forgive it, nor any sorrow except that You relieve it. O Allah, do not make him in need of anyone other than You.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3222.
grading: Ḍaʿīf in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3222)

name: Du'a to direct a father's heart
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قَلْبَهُ عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma Musarrifal-qulub, sarrif qalbahu 'ala ta'atik
translation: O Allah, Turner of the hearts, direct his heart to Your obedience.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2654.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2654)

name: Du'a for a father's mercy via the Qur'an
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْ أَبِي بِالْقُرْآنِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَهُ نُورًا وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً
transliteration: Allahummar-ham abi bil-Qur'an, waj'alhu lahu nuran wa hudan wa rahmah
translation: O Allah, have mercy on my father by the Qur'an, and make it a light, guidance, and mercy for him.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for the Qur'an to be the spring of a father's heart
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِهِ، وَشِفَاءَ صَدْرِهِ، وَنُورًا لِبَصَرِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma-j'alil-Qur'anal-'adhima rabi'a qalbihi, wa shifa'a sadrihi, wa nuran libasarihi
translation: O Allah, make the Great Qur'an the spring of his heart, the healing of his chest, and a light for his sight.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Musnad Aḥmad 3712.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Musnad Aḥmad 3712)

name: Du'a for a father's obedience
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلْ قَلْبَهُ بِحُبِّكَ، وَلِسَانَهُ بِذِكْرِكَ، وَبَدَنَهُ بِطَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahummash-ghal qalbahu bihubbik, wa lisanahu bidhikrik, wa badanahu bita'atik
translation: O Allah, occupy his heart with Your love, his tongue with Your remembrance, and his body with Your obedience.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a father's home and provision
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ ذَنْبَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ لَهُ فِي دَارِهِ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ
transliteration: Allahummaghfir lahu dhanbahu, wa wassi' lahu fi darihi, wa barik lahu fi rizqihi
translation: O Allah, forgive his sins, expand his home for him, and bless his provision.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3500.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3500)

name: Du'a for a father's independence from the unlawful
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِهِ بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِهِ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummak-fihi bihalalika 'an haramik, wa aghnihi bifadlika 'amman siwak
translation: O Allah, suffice him with Your lawful against Your prohibited, and make him independent of all those besides You by Your bounty.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3563.
grading: Ḥasan in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3563)

name: Du'a for a father's Paradise
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْ أَبِي الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرُبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ وَعَمَلٍ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرُبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ وَعَمَلٍ
transliteration: Allahummar-zuq abil-jannata wa ma qaruba ilayha min qawlin wa 'amal, wa ba'id baynahu wa baynan-nari wa ma qaruba ilayha min qawlin wa 'amal
translation: O Allah, grant my father Paradise and whatever words or actions bring him near to it, and distance him from the Hellfire and whatever words or actions bring him near to it.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Sunan Ibn Mājah 3846.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan Ibn Mājah 3846)

name: Du'a to guide a father among the guided
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ أَبِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِهِ فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ
transliteration: Allahummahdi abi fiman hadayt, wa 'afihi fiman 'afayt
translation: O Allah, guide my father among those You have guided, and grant him well-being among those You have granted well-being.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 464.
grading: Ḥasan Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 464)

name: Du'a for a father's success in guidance
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْ أَبِي لِهُدَاكَ، وَاجْعَلْ عَمَلَهُ فِي رِضَاكَ
transliteration: Allahumma waffiq abi lihudak, waj'al 'amalahu fi ridak
translation: O Allah, grant my father success in following Your guidance, and make his deeds pleasing to You.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a father's repentance
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ تَوْبَتَهُ، وَأَجِبْ دَعْوَتَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma taqabbal tawbatahu, wa ajib da'watahu
translation: O Allah, accept his repentance and answer his supplication.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3551.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3551)

name: Du'a for dutifulness to a father
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى بِرِّهِ حَتَّى يَرْضَى عَنِّي
transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala birrihi hatta yarda 'anni
translation: O Allah, help me to be dutiful to him until he is pleased with me.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a father's light
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَهُ فِي قَلْبِهِ نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِهِ نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِهِ نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِهِ نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِ نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ نُورًا، وَمِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ نُورًا
transliteration: Allahumma-j'al lahu fi qalbihi nura, wa fi lisanihi nura, wa fi sam'ihi nura, wa fi basarihi nura, wa min tahtihi nura, wa 'an yaminihi nura, wa 'an shimalihi nura, wa min bayni yadayhi nura, wa min khalfihi nura
translation: O Allah, place light in his heart, light on his tongue, light in his hearing, light in his sight, light beneath him, light on his right, light on his left, light before him, and light behind him.
source: Adapted into the third person masculine from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 763.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 763)

name: Du'a for a father's protection
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ أَثْمَنَ مَا عِنْدِي وَأَقْرَبَهَا إِلَى قَلْبِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْ لِي أَبِي وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْحَافِظِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni astawdi'uka athmana ma 'indi wa aqrabaha ila qalbi, Allahummah-fadh li abi wa anta khayrul-hafizhin
translation: O Allah, I entrust to You the most precious thing I have and the closest to my heart. O Allah, protect my father for me, for You are the best of protectors.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a father's happiness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْعِدْ قَلْبَ أَبِي، وَاشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُ، وَأَرِحْ قَلْبَهُ، وَأَبْعِدْ عَنْهُ كُلَّ مَا يُحْزِنُهُ، وَأَطِلْ عُمْرَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma as'id qalba abi, washrah sadrahu, wa arih qalbahu, wa ab'id 'anhu kulla ma yuhzinuhu, wa atil 'umrahu
translation: O Allah, bring happiness to my father's heart, expand his chest, comfort his heart, keep away from him all that saddens him, and prolong his life.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for a father's protection from sickness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَبْعِدْ عَنْهُ الْمَرَضَ، وَارْزُقْهُ طُولَ الْعُمْرِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma ab'id 'anhul-marad, warzuqhu tulal-'umri fi ta'atik
translation: O Allah, keep sickness away from him, and grant him a long life in Your obedience.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a of comprehensive praise and gratitude
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَحْمَدُكَ وَنَسْتَعِينُكَ وَنَسْتَهْدِيكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ كُلَّهُ، نَشْكُرُكَ وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنَتْرُكُ مَنْ يَفْجُرُكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كُلُّهُ، وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ كُلُّهُ، وَإِلَيْكَ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ، عَلَانِيَتُهُ وَسِرُّهُ، فَأَهْلٌ أَنْتَ أَنْ تُحْمَدَ، وَأَهْلٌ أَنْتَ أَنْ تُعْبَدَ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَتَّى تَرْضَى، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إِذَا رَضِيتَ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَالَّذِينَ قَالُوا خَيْرًا مِمَّا نَقُولُ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَالَّذِي تَقُولُ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ، اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، وَأَنْتَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
transliteration: Allahumma inna nahmaduka wa nasta'inuka wa nastahdika wa nastaghfiruka wa natubu ilayk, wa nuthni 'alaykal-khayra kullah, nashkuruka wa la nakfuruk, wa natruku man yafjuruk. Allahumma iyyaka na'bud, wa laka nusalli wa nasjud, wa ilayka nas'a wa nahfid, narju rahmataka wa nakhsha 'adhabak. Allahumma lakal-hamdu kulluh, wa lakash-shukru kulluh, wa ilayka yurja'ul-amru kulluh, 'alaniyatuhu wa sirruh, fa'ahlun anta an tuhmad, wa ahlun anta an tu'bad, wa anta 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma lakal-hamdu hatta tarda, wa lakal-hamdu idha radit, wa lakal-hamdu kalladhina qalu khayran mimma naqul, wa lakal-hamdu kalladhi taqul, wa lakal-hamdu 'ala kulli hal. Allahumma lakal-hamd, anta nurus-samawati wal-ard, wa anta bikulli shay'in 'alim.
translation: O Allah, we thank You and we ask You for help, guidance, and forgiveness. We praise You for all the good, we thank You and do not disbelieve in You, and we forsake those who disobey You. O Allah, You alone we worship, to You we pray and prostrate, to You we strive and hasten. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment. O Allah, all praise is Yours, all gratitude is Yours, and to You all matters return, the open and the secret. You are worthy of being praised, and You are worthy of being worshipped, and You are capable of all things. O Allah, to You is praise until You are pleased, to You is praise when You are pleased, and to You is praise like those who spoke better than what we say, and to You is praise like what You say, and to You is praise in every condition. O Allah, to You is praise; You are the light of the heavens and the earth, and You are all-knowing of everything.
source: A general supplication that includes the qunūt of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb (al-Sunan al-Kubrā lil-Bayhaqī 3143) with composed praise.
grading: Not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him); the qunūt is reported from ʿUmar (ṣaḥīḥ according to al-Albānī)

name: Du'a praising the Creator of the Universe
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، خَلَقَ اللَّوْحَ وَالْقَلَمَ، وَخَلَقَ الْخَلْقَ مِنْ عَدَمٍ، وَدَبَّرَ الْأَرْزَاقَ وَالْآجَالَ بِالْمَقَادِيرِ وَحُكْمٍ، وَجَمَّلَ اللَّيْلَ بِالنُّجُومِ فِي الظُّلَمِ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin, khalaqal-lawha wal-qalam, wa khalaqal-khalqa min 'adam, wa dabbaral-arzaqa wal-ajala bil-maqadiri wa hukm, wa jammalal-layla bin-nujumi fiz-zulam
translation: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. He created the Preserved Tablet and the Pen, created creation from nothing, arranged provisions and lifespans with measure and wisdom, and beautified the night with stars in the darkness.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Gratitude du'a: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks
arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحࣰا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِيٓۖ إِنِّي تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa aslih lee fee dhurriyyatee, innee tubtu ilayka wa innee minal muslimeen
translation: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee)

name: Du'a of deep gratitude
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، حَمْدًا لِشُكْرِهِ أَدَاءً، وَلِحَقِّهِ قَضَاءً، وَلِحُبِّهِ رَجَاءً، وَلِفَضْلِهِ نَمَاءً، وَلِثَوَابِهِ عَطَاءً
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin, hamdan lishukrihi ada'an, wa lihaqqihi qada'an, wa lihubbihi raja'an, wa lifadlihi nama'an, wa lithawabihi 'ata'an
translation: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds. Praise as an offering of thanks to Him, fulfilling His right, hoping for His love, acknowledging the growth of His bounty, and anticipating the gift of His reward.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a of glorification and forgiveness
arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ يَا رَبِّ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: Subhanaka ya rabb, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Subhanallahi, wal-hamdu lillahi, wa la ilaha illallahu, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim, rabbighfir li
translation: Glory is to You, O Lord. There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things. Glory is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. There is none worthy of worship but Allah. Allah is the Most Great. There is no might and no power except by Allah's leave, the Exalted, the Mighty. My Lord, forgive me.
source: Adapted from Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 1154 (the supplication on waking at night), with "Subḥānaka yā Rabb" added at the start.
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 1154)

name: Du'a of brief praise
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, subhanallahil-'azim
translation: Glory and praise be to Allah, glory be to Allah the Almighty.

name: Du'a praising the All-Knowing
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، صَاحِبِ الْعَظَمَةِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْبَطْنِ وَالْأَحْشَاءِ، فَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الْعُرُوقِ وَالْأَمْعَاءِ، فَسُبْحَانَكَ يَا رَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin, sahibil-'azamati wal-kibriya', ya'lamu ma fil-batni wal-ahsha', farraqa baynal-'uruqi wal-am'a', fasubhanaka ya rabbal-ardi was-sama'
translation: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds, the Possessor of Greatness and Majesty. He knows what is inside the womb and the entrails, and He separated the veins and the intestines. Glory be to You, O Lord of the earth and the sky.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a praising the Responsive Lord
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، يُحِبُّ مَنْ دَعَاهُ خَفِيًّا، وَيُجِيبُ مَنْ نَادَاهُ نَجِيًّا، وَيَزِيدُ مَنْ كَانَ حَيِيًّا، وَيُكْرِمُ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ وَفِيًّا، وَيَهْدِي مَنْ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ رَضِيًّا
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin, yuhibbu man da'ahu khafiyyan, wa yujibu man nadahu najiyyan, wa yazidu man kana hayiyyan, wa yukrimu man kana lahu wafiyyan, wa yahdi man kana sadiqil-wa'di radiyyan
translation: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds. He loves the one who calls upon Him secretly, and He responds to the one who pleads with Him privately, and He increases the one who is modest, and He honors the one who is loyal to Him, and He guides the one who is true to their promise and pleasing.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Gratitude du'a: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour
arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحࣰا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas-saaliheen
translation: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves

name: Du'a praising the Lord of destiny
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، الَّذِي جَعَلَ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدَرًا، وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ قَدَرٍ أَجَلًا، وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتَابًا
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin, alladhi ja'ala likulli shay'in qadaran, wa ja'ala likulli qadarin ajalan, wa ja'ala likulli ajalin kitaban
translation: All Praise is to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds, Who has made for everything a destiny, and made for every destiny a term, and made for every term a written decree.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a of absolute greatness
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Subhanallahi wal-hamdu lillahi, wa la ilaha illallahu, wallahu akbar, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim
translation: Glory is to Allah, and praise is to Allah, and there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest, and Allah is the Greatest. There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Magnificent.
source: A general supplication combining standard tahmid and takbir.

name: Du'a of angelic praise
arabic: سُبُّوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
transliteration: Subbuhun, quddusun, rabbul-mala'ikati war-ruh
translation: Glory to You, Most Holy are You, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

name: Du'a of dominion and majesty
arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ
transliteration: Subhana dhil-jabaruti, wal-malakuti, wal-kibriya'i, wal-'azamah
translation: Glory is to You, Master of power, of dominion, of majesty and greatness.

name: Du'a of gratitude for provision and shelter
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana, wa kafana, wa awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la mu'wi
translation: Praise is to Allah Who has provided us with food and with drink, sufficed us and gave us an abode, for how many are there with no provision and no home.

name: Du'a of abundant praise
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبُّنَا
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih, ghayra makfiyyin wa la muwadda'in, wa la mustaghnan 'anhu rabbuna
translation: Allah be praised with an abundant, beautiful, blessed praise; a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to, and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord.

name: Du'a for remembrance and gratitude
arabic: رَبِّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
transliteration: Rabbi a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
translation: My Lord, help me to remember You, give thanks to You and worship You well.

name: Du'a for the deceased after burial
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
transliteration: Allahummaghfir lahu, Allahumma thabbithu
translation: O Allah forgive him, O Allah stabilize him.
practiceTime: Recite Dua After Burying the Deceased

name: Du'a for protection from the punishment of the grave
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
transliteration: Allahumma a'idh-hu min 'adhabil-qabr
translation: O Allah protect him from the punishment of the grave.
practiceTime: Recite Dua for Deceased at all times
source: Adapted from Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 963, which reads "اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ... وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ"
grading: Ṣaḥīḥ in its original wording (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 963).

name: Du'a for a young child who has died
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطًا وَسَلَفًا وَأَجْرًا
transliteration: Allahummaj'alhu lana faratan wa salafan wa ajran
translation: O Allah make him a preceding reward, a prepayment, and a recompense for us.
practiceTime: For the loss of a young child
source: A statement of al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī for a child's funeral prayer, cited without a chain (muʿallaq) in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Book of Funerals, chapter 65.

name: Du'a when placing the deceased in the grave
arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وعَلَى سُنَّة رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَليهِ وَسَلَّم
transliteration: Bismallah Wa Aala Sunnati Rasooli Allah Salaa Allahu Alaihi Wa Salam
translation: In the Name of Allah and Upon the Sunnah the Messenger of Allah
practiceTime: When placing the deceased in the grave

name: Words of condolence: patience and reward
arabic: إنَّ لِلَّه مَا أخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيء عِندَهُ ِأجَل مُسَمَّى، فلْتَصْبِر وَلْتَحْتَسِب
transliteration: Inna Lillahi Maa Akhath waa lahu maa a'ataa Wa Kulu Shayin Indahu Ajailon musama faltosbir Wal tahtesib
translation: Definitely Allah has taken what belongs to him. He has given us what belongs to him. He has stipulated a time for everyone so have patience and hope for reward.

name: Words of condolence
arabic: أَعْظَمَ اللهُ أَجْرَك،وَأحْسَنَ عَزَاءَك، وَغَفَر لِمَيتكَ
transliteration: Atham Allahu Ajrak Wa Ahsana Azaak Wa Ghafara  Limay-yatik
translation: May Allah magnify your reward, Make better your solace and forgive your deceased.
source: A general supplication, not a narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him).

name: Du'a for the deceased in the funeral prayer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allahummaghfir lahu warhamhu, wa 'afihi wa'fu 'anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi' mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa abdilhu daran khayran min darihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhilhul-jannata, wa a'idh-hu min 'adhabil-qabri wa 'adhabin-nar.
translation: O Allah forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry and cleanse him with water, snow and ice and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into Jannah and protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Hellfire.

name: Du'a for our living and our dead
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
transliteration: Allahummaghfir lihayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa'ahyihi 'alal-islam, wa man tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu 'alal-iman. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu, wa la tudillana ba'dah.
translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.

name: Du'a entrusting the deceased to Allah's care
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Allahumma inna [say your loved one's name] fi dhimmatika, wa habli jiwarika, faqihi min fitnatil-qabri wa 'adhabin-nar, wa anta ahlul-wafa'i wal-haqq, faghfir lahu warhamhu, innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.
translation: O Allah, [say your loved one's name] is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Hellfire. Indeed you are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most Merciful.

name: Greeting when visiting the graveyard
arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أهْل الدِّيار، مِنَ المُؤْمِنِينَ والمُسْلِمينَ، وإنَّا إنْ شَاءَ اللهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُون ويَرحَمُ الله المُسْتقدِمينَ مِنَّا والمُسْتأخِرِي أسْألُ اللهَ لَنَا ولَكُمُ العَافِيَة
transliteration: Al- salam Alaykum Ahal Al- Diyaar min Al-mu’minin wa Al- Muslimeen Wa Inna inshallah bikum La hikoon Wa yarhamu allah al Mustakdemeen minna wa Al-musta’khirin As’aal Allah Lana Wa Lakum Al Aafiya.
translation: Peace be upon you all, O’ inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we ask Allah for Well-being for us and for you.

name: Du'a for the deceased in need of Allah's mercy
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
transliteration: Allahumma 'abduka wabnu amatika, ihtaja ila rahmatika, wa anta ghaniyyun 'an 'adhabihi, in kana muhsinan fazid fi hasanatihi, wa in kana musi'an fatajawaz 'anhu.
translation: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your Mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he did wrong, overlook his wrongdoing.

name: Du'a when closing the eyes of the deceased
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلَانٍ وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
transliteration: Allahummaghfir li [say your loved one's name] warfa' darajatahu fil-mahdiyyin, wakhlufhu fi 'aqibihi fil-ghabirin, waghfir lana wa lahu ya Rabbal-'alamin, wafsah lahu fi qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fih.
translation: O Allah, forgive [say your loved one's name] and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he left behind, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Make his grave spacious and illuminated for him.

name: Ayat al-Kursi
arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةࣱ وَلَا نَوۡمࣱۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءࣲ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
transliteration: Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa huwal haiyul qai-yoom laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa laa nawm; lahoo maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard man zallazee yashfa’u indahooo illaa be iznih ya’lamu maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona beshai ‘immin ‘ilmihee illa be maa sha  wasi’a kursiyyuhus samaa waati wal arda wa la ya’ooduho hifzuhumaa wa huwal aliyyul ‘azeem
translation: Allah! There is no God save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous

name: Surah Al-Ikhlas (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul Huwallaahu Ahad, Allaahus-Samad, lam yalid wa lam yoolad, wa lam yakul lahu kufuwan ahad
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: He is Allah, the One Allah, the eternally Besought of all He begetteth not nor was begotten And there is none comparable unto Him

name: Surah Al-Falaq (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbil-falaq, min sharri maa khalaq, wa min sharri ghaasiqin idhaa waqab, wa min sharrin-naffaathaati fil-'uqad, wa min sharri haasidin idhaa hasad
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak From the evil of that which He created From the evil of the darkness when it is intense And from the evil of malignant witchcraft And from the evil of the envier when he envieth

name: Surah An-Nas (three times)
arabic:
بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbin-naas, Malikin-naas, Ilaahin-naas, min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas, alladhee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas, minal-jinnati wan-naas
translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind The King of mankind The God of mankind From the evil of the sneaking whisperer Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind Of the jinn and of mankind

name: The last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah
arabic: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدࣲ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦۚ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۖ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا مَا ٱكۡتَسَبَتۡۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرࣰا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
